literature.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 通过多种算法检测到两个不同的重组事件,代表全球记录的第二个独立的 Ib/IIb 间重组事件。 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2760649]
该研究报告了西班牙的 11 例 猴痘病毒 分支 Ib 病例,临床表现主要为轻度。 [10.1097/olq.0000000000002452]
该患者在返回英国一天后出现肛门生殖器病变,临床诊断为原发性单纯疱疹病毒,并开始口服阿昔洛韦,但没有病变取样。PCR 检测后来证实了进化枝 II 猴痘,而所有其他 STI 检测仍呈阴性。 [10.1136/bcr-2026-273362]
数值模拟表明,提高公众意识和及时干预可以有效减轻疾病负担并改善 暴发 控制。使用下一代矩阵方法推导基本再生数$R_0$,并分析无病平衡和地方病平衡的局部稳定性。 [10.1140/epjp/s13360-026-08514-7]
研究报告称,猴痘 传播 继续存在于 Clade 2b 菌株中,而 Clade 1b 猴痘 已在撒哈拉以南非洲以外的地区观察到,表明 暴发 的地理分布发生了变化。 [10.1016/j.ebiom.2026.106559]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Two distinct recombination events were detected by multiple algorithms, representing the second independent interclade Ib/IIb recombination event documented globally. [10.1080/22221751.2026.2760649]
The study reported 11 cases of mpox virus clade Ib in Spain, with the clinical presentation predominantly being mild. [10.1097/olq.0000000000002452]

The patient developed anogenital lesions a day after returning to the UK, was clinically diagnosed with primary HSV, and started on oral aciclovir without lesion sampling. PCR testing later confirmed clade II mpox, while all other STI tests remained negative. [10.1136/bcr-2026-273362]
Numerical simulations demonstrated that increased public awareness and timely interventions effectively reduce disease burden and improve outbreak control. [10.1140/epjp/s13360-026-08514-7]

The study reported that mpox transmission has continued with the Clade 2b strain and that Clade 1b mpox has been observed outside of sub-Saharan Africa, indicating a shift in the outbreak's geographic distribution. [10.1016/j.ebiom.2026.106559]

news.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 柬埔寨在失踪 30 个月后确认了首例新的 猴痘 病例。卫生部报告了该病例,并敦促公民保持警惕,防止聚集性或大规模的暴发。 [news-2d5fc7b842a1538a]
性传播感染 (STI) - 世界卫生组织 (WHO)。 [news-84c9e2404b25d54c]
柬埔寨发现首例新病例 猴痘(也称为猴痘),此前该病毒已在该国消失 30 个月零 6 天。卫生部证实了这一消息。 [news-52f9b6216db08418]
据《湾区报道》2026 年 11 月 20 日报道,旧金山卫生官员警告称,一种更严重的 猴痘病毒 病毒株正在该市蔓延。 [news-55d4547d9bc26274]
柬埔寨确诊 30 个月零 6 天以来首例 猴痘 病例。卫生部报告了该病例,并强调需要保持警惕并采取预防措施,以避免进一步传播。 [news-9b022c0271f0e69d]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Mpox virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Cambodia confirmed its first new mpox case after 30 months of absence. The Ministry of Health reported the case and urged citizens to remain vigilant to prevent clusters or large-scale outbreaks. [news-2d5fc7b842a1538a]
Sexually transmitted infections (STIs) - World Health Organization (WHO). [news-84c9e2404b25d54c]

Cambodia has detected its first new case of mpox, also known as monkeypox, after the virus had been absent from the country for 30 months and six days. This was confirmed by the Ministry of Health. [news-52f9b6216db08418]
Health officials in San Francisco warned about a more severe strain of the mpox virus spreading in the city, as reported by the Bay Area Reporter on November 20, 2026. [news-55d4547d9bc26274]

papers.title: Human infection with a putative novel interclade recombinant monkeypox virus: a public health warning of emerging clade Ib/IIb recombinants.
papers.abstract: We report a putative novel interclade Ib/IIb MPXV recombinant.2. This is the first putative interclade Ib/IIb MPXV recombinant identified in China.3. Two distinct recombination events were detected by multiple algorithms.4. Routine clade-specific PCR mistyping underscores the necessity of whole-genome sequencing.To the Editor Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is an emerging zoonotic pathogen with increasing human-to-human transmission.The virus is divided into two major phylogenetic clades: Clade I and Clade II (including subclades Ia, Ib, IIa, and IIb), which differ markedly in virulence, transmissibility, and host adaptation.Experimental studies have consistently demonstrated a virulence gradient of Clade I > Clade IIa > Clade IIb [1].The recently emerged Clade Ib lineage, first identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 2023, exhibits sustained human-to-human transmission and virulence exceeding that of the globally circulating Clade IIb lineage [2].Genomic analyses indicate ongoing viral adaptation during human transmission, driven by APOBEC3-mediated mutations and changes in virulence-associated genes [3].While Clade IIb was responsible for the 2022-2024 global outbreak, predominantly via sexual transmission networks, Clade Ib has increasingly spread through household and community contacts, thereby expanding opportunities for wider dissemination [4, 5].Alongside mutation and selection, homologous recombination is a major mechanism of poxvirus evolution.The recent global co -circulation of Clade Ib and Clade IIb has created conditions favorable for the emergence of Clade Ib/IIb recombinants.In December 2025, a viable interclade recombinant MPXV comprising genomic regions from both Clade Ib and Clade IIb was detected in England [6], and a closely related virus was subsequently identified in India, suggesting international spread before recognition.Here, we report the first identified case of human infection with a putative novel interclade recombinant MPXV (Clade Ib/IIb) in China, as of August 17, 2026.This finding represents the second independent interclade Ib/IIb recombination event documented worldwide (the three previously reported UK/India genomes constitute a single event) and serves as a public health warning of the potentially ongoing emergence of Clade Ib/IIb recombinants.

source_records.title: Human infection with a putative novel interclade recombinant monkeypox virus: a public health warning of emerging clade Ib/IIb recombinants.
source_records.abstract: The co-circulation of monkeypox virus (MPXV) clades Ib and IIb creates opportunities for interclade recombination, with potential implications for diagnosis, viral fitness, and public health. We investigated a 34-year-old man in Hangzhou, China, who presented with penile vesicles and a subsequent maculopapular rash in June 2026. Routine clade-specific PCR identified a Clade Ib infection; however, whole-genome sequencing of throat-swab and blister-fluid specimens revealed a putative novel Clade Ib/IIb recombinant virus. Independent DNA extraction and both metagenomic and tiled long-amplicon sequencing confirmed identical recombination regions in both specimens, with full-length amplicons covering all four major breakpoint zones. SNP-based ancestry mapping identified a Clade Ib backbone containing a central Clade IIb insertion that was interrupted by a nested Clade Ib segment. RDP analysis using seven algorithms supported two recombination events, and the inferred breakpoints were concordant with the ancestry mapping. Phylogenetic analysis assigned the Clade Ib backbone to lineage A.4.1 and the Clade IIb insertion to lineage C.1.2. The recombinant virus differed substantially from previously reported UK/India recombinants and shared no breakpoints with them, indicating an independent origin. This finding suggests that recombinants may emerge rapidly when divergent clades co-circulate and highlights the limitations of clade-specific PCR alone, underscoring the need for sustained whole-genome sequencing and genomic surveillance.

papers.title_zh: 人类感染一种假定的新型进化枝重组猴痘病毒:新兴进化枝 Ib/IIb 重组体的公共卫生警告。
papers.source_body_en: We report a putative novel interclade Ib/IIb MPXV recombinant.2. This is the first putative interclade Ib/IIb MPXV recombinant identified in China.3. Two distinct recombination events were detected by multiple algorithms.4. Routine clade-specific PCR mistyping underscores the necessity of whole-genome sequencing.To the Editor Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is an emerging zoonotic pathogen with increasing human-to-human transmission.The virus is divided into two major phylogenetic clades: Clade I and Clade II (including subclades Ia, Ib, IIa, and IIb), which differ markedly in virulence, transmissibility, and host adaptation.Experimental studies have consistently demonstrated a virulence gradient of Clade I > Clade IIa > Clade IIb [1].The recently emerged Clade Ib lineage, first identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 2023, exhibits sustained human-to-human transmission and virulence exceeding that of the globally circulating Clade IIb lineage [2].Genomic analyses indicate ongoing viral adaptation during human transmission, driven by APOBEC3-mediated mutations and changes in virulence-associated genes [3].While Clade IIb was responsible for the 2022-2024 global outbreak, predominantly via sexual transmission networks, Clade Ib has increasingly spread through household and community contacts, thereby expanding opportunities for wider dissemination [4, 5].Alongside mutation and selection, homologous recombination is a major mechanism of poxvirus evolution.The recent global co -circulation of Clade Ib and Clade IIb has created conditions favorable for the emergence of Clade Ib/IIb recombinants.In December 2025, a viable interclade recombinant MPXV comprising genomic regions from both Clade Ib and Clade IIb was detected in England [6], and a closely related virus was subsequently identified in India, suggesting international spread before recognition.Here, we report the first identified case of human infection with a putative novel interclade recombinant MPXV (Clade Ib/IIb) in China, as of August 17, 2026.This finding represents the second independent interclade Ib/IIb recombination event documented worldwide (the three previously reported UK/India genomes constitute a single event) and serves as a public health warning of the potentially ongoing emergence of Clade Ib/IIb recombinants.

papers.title: New mpox data amid an evolving outbreak.
papers.abstract: We are four years into the global mpox outbreak with continued widespread transmission of the Clade 2b strain, and more recently transmission of Clade 1b mpox outside of sub-Saharan Africa. We have no proven therapeutics for mpox other than supportive care. Most countermeasures used during the outbreak were developed for smallpox and approved without human efficacy data for mpox.1 We are now faced with an ongoing, smouldering outbreak, with low case counts, that makes vaccine and treatment trials challenging to enrol.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于全球 猴痘 暴发 正在进行,特别是撒哈拉以南非洲以外的分支 2b 的 传播 和最近的分支 1b 猴痘,因此需要进行这项研究,强调需要更好地了解和管理该疾病。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注 猴痘 暴发,检查其在不同地区和人群中的传播和特征,特别关注 Clade 1b 菌株在撒哈拉以南非洲以外地区的出现。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究利用现有数据和报告来分析 传播 模式和 猴痘 的特征,特别是 Clade 1b 菌株,而无需进行新的实验或试验。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究报告称,猴痘 传播 继续存在于 Clade 2b 菌株中,而 Clade 1b 猴痘 已在撒哈拉以南非洲以外的地区观察到,表明 暴发 的地理分布发生了变化。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为 暴发 不断演变的证据,新的 传播 模式不断出现,并指出分支 1b 菌株传播到其传统流行区域之外的新颖性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明需要更新 监测 策略,并强调监测新的 传播 模式的重要性,特别是对于 Clade 1b 猴痘,以便更好地为未来的 暴发 做好准备。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据基于现有报告,在数据完整性和实时准确性方面可能存在局限性,但研究结果得到多个来源的支持,被认为具有中等可信度。

papers.title: Monkeypox Virus Seroprevalence among Adults Assessed at Roadside Wellness Centers along Major Transportation Corridor, Kenya, 2025.
papers.abstract: A critical, annotated version of Narlikar’s iconic novel about a cybervirus attack by an advanced alien species—with updated text and added material. A year before Robin Cook’s Invasion (1997)—in which an alien force activates a latent biological virus in humans—and almost a decade before Liu Cixin’s The Remembrance of Earth’s Past trilogy (2008–2010)—in which humanity’s scientific progress is curtailed by an alien supercomputer’s “sophon-lock”—Jayant Vishnu Narlikar’s Virus (1996) painted a similar scenario. In his novel, a cybervirus broadcast by an advanced, extraterrestrial species invades Earth and freezes its digital infrastructure: a prelude to an alien invasion. The novel, first published in Marathi, recounts how vast radio arrays on Earth intercept a seemingly innocuous message from an unknown planet orbiting Barnard’s Star. The radio signal, sent six years prior, coalesces into a cybervirus that has the potential to cause a complete digital meltdown and lead humanity into an age of chaos—an alien first strike to prevent humanity from evolving further. This book—a critical, annotated version of Virus, edited and revised by Sami Ahmad Khan—reissues Narlikar’s iconic novel with updated text and added dimensions. It includes detailed annotations that locate the technology of the text along the axis of contemporary scientific thought, as well as critical essays that focus on the literary, political, and sociocultural dimensions of the novel; essays on Narlikar’s role in India’s science and science fiction; an exclusive conversation with the author; bibliographical information on his works; and a bonus short story. Contributions by Sami Ahmad Khan, Nilam Ingole, Priteegandha Naik, Jayant V. Narlikar, and Dibyadyuti Roy.

source_records.title: Monkeypox Virus Seroprevalence among Adults Assessed at Roadside Wellness Centers along Major Transportation Corridor, Kenya, 2025.
source_records.abstract: Since 2024, Kenya has confirmed >1,000 cases of monkeypox virus (MPXV) infection. We conducted a cross-sectional serosurvey at 8 clinics along a transportation corridor in Kenya to quantify unrecognized MPXV transmission. From September 29-October 28, 2025, adults >18 years completed a questionnaire and provided blood samples tested with a serologic assay that distinguishes likely MPXV infection from orthopoxvirus vaccination. We used a modified Poisson regression to assess associations with likely MPXV infection. We compared participants with serologic evidence of MPXV infection to those self-reporting prior confirmed mpox cases. Of 2,896 participants, 332 (11.5%) were seropositive, including 82 (2.8%) classified as likely MPXV infection. Four participants reported prior confirmed MPXV cases, yielding a 21:1 ratio of participants with serologic evidence of MPXV infection to self-reported confirmed cases. Despite some evidence of undetected transmission, most participants lacked serologic evidence of prior orthopoxvirus exposure, indicating a large susceptible population and supporting additional vaccination and ongoing serosurveillance.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the Monkeypox virus (Orthopoxvirus monkeypox), MPXV clades, and mpox disease. It examines the seroprevalence of the mpox virus among adults assessed at roadside wellness centers along a major transportation corridor in Kenya in 2025. The central question is to understand the extent of mpox virus exposure in this population and its implications for public health.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a narrative analysis of a single novel, which is not a scientific study. It does not report on databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, or study counts. The evidence is derived from literary interpretations and annotations, not from empirical data or meta-analysis.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the Monkeypox virus, as depicted in the novel, has the potential to cause a complete digital meltdown and lead humanity into an age of chaos. It highlights the virus's role as an alien first strike to prevent further human evolution, suggesting a significant threat to global infrastructure and societal stability.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review presents a speculative narrative without empirical evidence or scientific consensus. It lacks data on actual seroprevalence rates, transmission dynamics, or public health responses. The interpretation of the virus's impact is based on fictional scenarios, which do not provide concrete evidence for real-world implications.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that further research into the biological and digital implications of the Monkeypox virus is needed, particularly in understanding its potential to disrupt global infrastructure. It also implies the need for enhanced surveillance and preparedness for emerging viral threats, especially those with dual biological and technological dimensions.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the Monkeypox virus through a fictional narrative, focusing on its seroprevalence among adults in Kenya. It highlights the virus's potential to cause digital infrastructure collapse and societal chaos, framed as an alien first strike. The review lacks empirical data and scientific consensus, presenting speculative scenarios instead. It underscores the need for research into the virus's biological and technological impacts, as well as improved surveillance for emerging viral threats.

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 评论的结论是,正如小说中所描述的,猴痘病毒有可能导致数字彻底崩溃,并导致人类进入一个混乱的时代。它强调了该病毒作为外星人首次攻击的作用,以阻止进一步的人类 进化,这表明对全球基础设施和社会稳定构成重大威胁。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论提出了一种推测性叙述,没有经验证据或科学共识。它缺乏有关实际 血清流行率 比率、传播 动态或公共卫生应对措施的数据。对病毒影响的解释是基于虚构的场景,并没有为现实世界的影响提供具体的证据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查表明,需要进一步研究猴痘病毒的生物和数字影响,特别是在了解其破坏全球基础设施的潜力方面。它还意味着需要加强 监测 并为新出现的病毒威胁做好准备,特别是那些具有双重生物和技术维度的病毒威胁。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the Monkeypox virus (Orthopoxvirus monkeypox), MPXV clades, and mpox disease. It examines the seroprevalence of the mpox virus among adults assessed at roadside wellness centers along a major transportation corridor in Kenya in 2025. The central question is to understand the extent of mpox virus exposure in this population and its implications for public health.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a narrative analysis of a single novel, which is not a scientific study. It does not report on databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, or study counts. The evidence is derived from literary interpretations and annotations, not from empirical data or meta-analysis.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the Monkeypox virus, as depicted in the novel, has the potential to cause a complete digital meltdown and lead humanity into an age of chaos. It highlights the virus's role as an alien first strike to prevent further human evolution, suggesting a significant threat to global infrastructure and societal stability.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review presents a speculative narrative without empirical evidence or scientific consensus. It lacks data on actual seroprevalence rates, transmission dynamics, or public health responses. The interpretation of the virus's impact is based on fictional scenarios, which do not provide concrete evidence for real-world implications.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that further research into the biological and digital implications of the Monkeypox virus is needed, particularly in understanding its potential to disrupt global infrastructure. It also implies the need for enhanced surveillance and preparedness for emerging viral threats, especially those with dual biological and technological dimensions.

papers.title_zh: 2025 年,在肯尼亚主要交通走廊沿线的路边健康中心对成人中的猴痘病毒 血清流行率 进行了评估。
papers.source_body_en: A critical, annotated version of Narlikar’s iconic novel about a cybervirus attack by an advanced alien species—with updated text and added material. A year before Robin Cook’s Invasion (1997)—in which an alien force activates a latent biological virus in humans—and almost a decade before Liu Cixin’s The Remembrance of Earth’s Past trilogy (2008–2010)—in which humanity’s scientific progress is curtailed by an alien supercomputer’s “sophon-lock”—Jayant Vishnu Narlikar’s Virus (1996) painted a similar scenario. In his novel, a cybervirus broadcast by an advanced, extraterrestrial species invades Earth and freezes its digital infrastructure: a prelude to an alien invasion. The novel, first published in Marathi, recounts how vast radio arrays on Earth intercept a seemingly innocuous message from an unknown planet orbiting Barnard’s Star. The radio signal, sent six years prior, coalesces into a cybervirus that has the potential to cause a complete digital meltdown and lead humanity into an age of chaos—an alien first strike to prevent humanity from evolving further. This book—a critical, annotated version of Virus, edited and revised by Sami Ahmad Khan—reissues Narlikar’s iconic novel with updated text and added dimensions. It includes detailed annotations that locate the technology of the text along the axis of contemporary scientific thought, as well as critical essays that focus on the literary, political, and sociocultural dimensions of the novel; essays on Narlikar’s role in India’s science and science fiction; an exclusive conversation with the author; bibliographical information on his works; and a bonus short story. Contributions by Sami Ahmad Khan, Nilam Ingole, Priteegandha Naik, Jayant V. Narlikar, and Dibyadyuti Roy.
papers.abstract_zh: 纳利卡标志性小说的批判性注释版本,讲述了高级外星物种发起的网络病毒攻击,并更新了文本和添加了材料。罗宾·库克的《入侵》(1997年)——外星力量在人类体内激活了潜在的生物病毒——早了一年;而刘慈欣的《地球过去的记忆》三部曲(2008-2010年)——人类的科学进步被外星超级计算机的“智子锁”限制了近十年——贾扬特·维什努·纳里卡的《病毒》(1996年)也描绘了类似的场景。在他的小说中,一种由先进的外星物种传播的网络病毒入侵地球并冻结了其数字基础设施:这是外星人入侵的前奏。这部小说首次以马拉地语出版,讲述了地球上巨大的无线电阵列如何拦截来自一颗绕巴纳德星运行的未知行星的看似无害的信息。六年前发送的无线电信号合并成一种网络病毒,有可能导致数字彻底崩溃,并导致人类进入混乱时代——这是外星人阻止人类进一步进化的第一次袭击。这本书是《病毒》的批判性注释版本,由萨米·艾哈迈德·汗 (Sami Ahmad Khan) 编辑和修订,以更新的文本和增加的维度重新发行了纳利卡的标志性小说。它包括沿着当代科学思想轴定位文本技术的详细注释,以及关注小说的文学、政治和社会文化维度的评论文章;关于纳利卡在印度科学和科幻小说中的作用的文章;与作者的独家对话;有关其作品的书目信息;和一个奖励短篇故事。Sami Ahmad Khan、Nilam Ingole、Priteegandha Naik、Jayant V. Narlikar 和 Dibyadyuti Roy 的贡献。

papers.title: Emergence of mpox virus clade Ib cases in Spain: a four-year surveillance study (2022-2026).
papers.abstract: Mpox virus clade Ib emerged in Spain in November 2025, with 11 cases detected in our cohort through May 2026. The clinical presentation was predominantly mild. The emergence of clade Ib MPXV cases in Spain underscores the importance of rapid and accurate molecular surveillance for clade identification. SUMMARY: A four-year surveillance study documented the first case series of mpox virus clade Ib infections in Spain, detected in 2025-2026, and presenting with predominantly mild disease.

papers.title: Clade II mpox mimicking primary herpes simplex virus and complicated by acute urinary retention following sexual exposure abroad.
papers.abstract: Clade II mpox frequently presents as localised anogenital disease and may closely resemble herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection. We report PCR confirmed clade II mpox in a previously healthy man following sexual exposure in Spain. On return to the UK, he presented to a sexual health service with rectal pain. Sexually transmitted infection (STI) screening, including HSV PCR, HIV and syphilis serology, was performed and all the results were negative. He developed anogenital lesion a day later and attended urgent care where he was clinically diagnosed with primary HSV and commenced on oral aciclovir without lesion sampling. Lesions progressed rapidly despite therapy. On relocation days later, he presented to Accident and Emergency with acute urinary retention. Referral to local Genitourinary Medicine service resulted in repeat STI plus other testing. All the results were negative except mpox clade II PCR. This case highlights the importance of epidemiological reasoning, comprehensive STI assessment, structured evaluation and system-level strategies to mitigate diagnostic anchoring.

Upon returning to the UK, he presented with rectal pain and was initially diagnosed with primary herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection. STI screening, including HSV PCR, HIV and syphilis serology, was negative. He developed anogenital lesions and was treated with oral aciclovir without lesion sampling. Later, PCR testing confirmed clade II mpox, while other STI tests remained negative. The study is a single case report, which may limit generalizability, but the evidence is strong due to PCR confirmation and detailed clinical observations. The findings have implications for improving diagnostic strategies and increasing awareness of mpox among healthcare providers, particularly in cases with overlapping symptoms with HSV.

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单个 病例报告,可能无法推广。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它包括对进化枝 II 猴痘 的 PCR 确认和详细的临床观察。

papers.title: Real-world safety assessment of Mpox Vaccine in Catalonia: Retrospective Cohort Study of Adverse Events of Special Interest and Breakthrough Infections
papers.abstract: Abstract Mpox vaccination with the Modified Vaccinia Ankara-Bavarian Nordic (MVA-BN) vaccine has been used to protect people at increased risk of infection, but real-world safety data from Europe remain limited. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 8,039 adults in Catalonia, Spain, who received at least one MVA-BN dose between June 13, 2022 and December 31, 2024, using routinely collected primary care and linked hospital records. We looked for five prespecified adverse events of special interest (myocarditis, pericarditis, thrombocytopenia, anaphylaxis and generalized convulsive seizure) within 28 days after each dose, and described mpox infections diagnosed after vaccination. Participants were predominantly men (97.7%) and aged 26–45 years (68.0%). Adverse events were rare: fewer than five cases of pericarditis occurred within 28 days of vaccination (day 19 after the first dose), and no other event of special interest was identified in that window. Sixteen participants (0.20%; 95% confidence interval 0.11–0.32%) had a recorded mpox diagnosis after vaccination. These findings provide preliminary, region-specific reassurance about the short-term safety of MVA-BN. However, events were few, there was no unvaccinated comparison group, and the study cannot establish causality or vaccine effectiveness. Continued monitoring of vaccine safety is warranted.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted a retrospective cohort analysis of 8,039 adults in Catalonia, Spain, who received the MVA-BN Mpox vaccine between June 2022 and December 2024. The research aimed to evaluate the vaccine's safety by identifying adverse events of special interest within 28 days of vaccination and describing mpox infections post-vaccination. The results indicated that adverse events were rare, with fewer than five cases of pericarditis observed and no other special interest events identified. Sixteen individuals (0.20%) had mpox diagnoses after vaccination. The study provided preliminary reassurance about the vaccine's short-term safety in the region but highlighted limitations, including the absence of a control group and the inability to establish causality. These findings contribute to understanding vaccine safety in Europe but require further investigation.

elements_zh.main_results: 疫苗接种 的 28 天内发生的心包炎病例少于 5 例,并且在该窗口中没有发现其他特别值得关注的事件。16 名参与者(0.20%;95% 置信区间 0.11–0.32%)在 疫苗接种 之后记录了 猴痘 诊断。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于事件较少、缺乏未接种疫苗的对照组以及无法确定因果关系或 疫苗 有效性,该研究的证据有限。

papers.title: Respiratory Symptoms in Patients with Mpox: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Monkeypox (Mpox) is a zoonotic disease caused by the mpox virus, which has posed a serious threat to global public health security, especially since the worldwide outbreak in 2022. Nevertheless, current studies on the respiratory symptoms of Mpox remain limited. This analysis aims to estimate the pooled prevalence and explore sources of heterogeneity. Methods We searched PubMed, Embase, and other databases for Mpox studies published up to December 2024. The included studies were observational studies that reported at least one respiratory symptom. We employed the metaprop command in Stata software (Version 12.0) to obtain the pooled prevalence and its 95% confidence interval ( CI ). Results Finally, a total of 25 studies on the respiratory symptoms of Mpox patients were included in the analysis. The primary reported respiratory symptoms included sore throat (18%, 95% CI 13%-23%), oral lesions (17%, 95% CI 13%-22%), cough (16%, 95% CI 9%-24%), and tonsillar signs (7%, 95% CI 4%-12%). Subgroup analysis was performed according to the male proportion and geographic region of the study population, in an effort to identify the source of heterogeneity. Conclusions Sore throat is the most prevalent respiratory symptom in Mpox patients, followed by oral lesions, cough, and tonsillar signs. Further research is needed to explore potential respiratory transmission modes in mpox patients, the possibility of inducing respiratory diseases in clinical settings, and identify typical respiratory indicators that can aid in early diagnosis. This work will contribute to developing more effective and accurate prevention and control strategies.

The pooled prevalence of sore throat was 18% (95% CI 13%-23%), followed by oral lesions (17%, 95% CI 13%-22%), cough (16%, 95% CI 9%-24%), and tonsillar signs (7%, 95% CI 4%-12%). Subgroup analyses were conducted based on the male proportion and geographic region of the study population to identify potential sources of heterogeneity. The findings suggest that sore throat is the most common respiratory symptom in Mpox patients. The review highlights the need for further research to explore respiratory transmission modes, the risk of respiratory diseases in clinical settings, and the identification of early diagnostic indicators. These insights could aid in developing more effective prevention and control strategies for Mpox.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Monkeypox (Mpox) is a zoonotic disease caused by the mpox virus, which has posed a serious threat to global public health security, especially since the worldwide outbreak in 2022. Nevertheless, current studies on the respiratory symptoms of Mpox remain limited. This analysis aims to estimate the pooled prevalence and explore sources of heterogeneity. Methods We searched PubMed, Embase, and other databases for Mpox studies published up to December 2024. The included studies were observational studies that reported at least one respiratory symptom. We employed the metaprop command in Stata software (Version 12.0) to obtain the pooled prevalence and its 95% confidence interval ( CI ). Results Finally, a total of 25 studies on the respiratory symptoms of Mpox patients were included in the analysis. The primary reported respiratory symptoms included sore throat (18%, 95% CI 13%-23%), oral lesions (17%, 95% CI 13%-22%), cough (16%, 95% CI 9%-24%), and tonsillar signs (7%, 95% CI 4%-12%). Subgroup analysis was performed according to the male proportion and geographic region of the study population, in an effort to identify the source of heterogeneity. Conclusions Sore throat is the most prevalent respiratory symptom in Mpox patients, followed by oral lesions, cough, and tonsillar signs. Further research is needed to explore potential respiratory transmission modes in mpox patients, the possibility of inducing respiratory diseases in clinical settings, and identify typical respiratory indicators that can aid in early diagnosis. This work will contribute to developing more effective and accurate prevention and control strategies.

papers.title: Nationwide genomic surveillance of Mpox clade IIb reveals APOBEC3-driven evolution, terminal deletions, and clade Ib introductions
papers.abstract: The 2022–2023 global mpox outbreak highlighted the critical need for robust genomic surveillance capabilities to track mpox virus (MPXV) evolution and transmission dynamics. Building upon our established SARS-CoV-2 sequencing infrastructure, we implemented a Molecular Loop ® probe-based long-read sequencing approach using Pacific Biosciences Sequel II technology for comprehensive MPXV genomic surveillance across the United States (US). From August 2024 to June 2025, we generated 326 high-quality whole genome sequences from residual mpox-positive clinical specimens collected by Labcorp across all 10 US Department of Health and Human Services regions. Our analysis identified two samples containing clade Ib MPXV in January and June 2025 and captured shifting trends in clade IIb diversity, with 12 distinct lineages observed. We also identified multiple instances of large (~ 1.6–17.6 kb) deletions proximal to the inverted terminal repeats in clade IIb genomes. APOBEC3 mutation analysis indicated substantial evidence of human-to-human transmission among both clades. Further, we observed significantly higher APOBEC3-associated SNPs per kilobase ( P < 0.001) in clade IIb genomic variable regions relative to their central conserved region. Our assay exhibited strong reproducibility across biological replicates from individual patients and accuracy was confirmed via parallel sequencing of select specimens by US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) using metagenomic sequencing. We also demonstrated via custom simulation that our assay discriminates all known MPXV clades and lineages, including those we have not observed in the US. Our integrated nationwide surveillance system facilitates real-time genomic tracking of outbreak evolution, with demonstrated capacity across SARS-CoV-2 and MPXV, positioning this platform for rapid deployment during future pathogen emergence.

papers.title_zh: 猴痘 clade IIb 的全国 基因组监测 揭示了 APOBEC3 驱动的 进化、末端删除和 clade Ib 引入
papers.source_body_en: The 2022–2023 global mpox outbreak highlighted the critical need for robust genomic surveillance capabilities to track mpox virus (MPXV) evolution and transmission dynamics. Building upon our established SARS-CoV-2 sequencing infrastructure, we implemented a Molecular Loop ® probe-based long-read sequencing approach using Pacific Biosciences Sequel II technology for comprehensive MPXV genomic surveillance across the United States (US). From August 2024 to June 2025, we generated 326 high-quality whole genome sequences from residual mpox-positive clinical specimens collected by Labcorp across all 10 US Department of Health and Human Services regions. Our analysis identified two samples containing clade Ib MPXV in January and June 2025 and captured shifting trends in clade IIb diversity, with 12 distinct lineages observed. We also identified multiple instances of large (~ 1.6–17.6 kb) deletions proximal to the inverted terminal repeats in clade IIb genomes. APOBEC3 mutation analysis indicated substantial evidence of human-to-human transmission among both clades. Further, we observed significantly higher APOBEC3-associated SNPs per kilobase ( P < 0.001) in clade IIb genomic variable regions relative to their central conserved region. Our assay exhibited strong reproducibility across biological replicates from individual patients and accuracy was confirmed via parallel sequencing of select specimens by US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) using metagenomic sequencing. We also demonstrated via custom simulation that our assay discriminates all known MPXV clades and lineages, including those we have not observed in the US. Our integrated nationwide surveillance system facilitates real-time genomic tracking of outbreak evolution, with demonstrated capacity across SARS-CoV-2 and MPXV, positioning this platform for rapid deployment during future pathogen emergence.
papers.abstract_zh: 2022-2023 年全球 猴痘 暴发 强调了对强大的 基因组监测 功能的迫切需求,以跟踪 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 进化 和 传播 动态。在我们已建立的 SARS-CoV-2 测序基础设施的基础上,我们使用 Pacific Biosciences Sequel II 技术实施了基于 Molecular Loop ® 探针的长读长测序方法,以在美国 (US) 进行全面的 MPXV 基因组监测。从 2024 年 8 月到 2025 年 6 月,我们从 Labcorp 在美国卫生与公众服务部所有 10 个地区收集的残留 猴痘 阳性临床标本中生成了 326 个高质量的完整 基因组 序列。我们的分析在 2025 年 1 月和 6 月鉴定了两个含有进化枝 Ib MPXV 的样本,并捕获了进化枝 IIb 多样性的变化趋势,观察到了 12 个不同的谱系。我们还在进化枝 IIb 基因组 中的反向末端重复序列附近发现了多个大(约 1.6-17.6 kb)缺失的实例。APOBEC3 突变 分析表明两个进化枝之间存在人与人之间的 传播 的大量证据。此外,我们观察到,相对于中央保守区,进化枝 IIb 基因组可变区中每千碱基的 APOBEC3 相关 SNP 显着更高(P < 0.001)。我们的检测在个体患者的生物重复中表现出很强的重现性,并且美国疾病控制和预防中心 (CDC) 使用宏基因组测序对选定样本进行并行测序,从而证实了准确性。我们还通过定制模拟证明,我们的检测可以区分所有已知的 MPXV 进化枝和谱系,包括我们在美国未观察到的那些。我们的综合全国 监测 系统有助于对 暴发 进化 进行实时基因组跟踪,并在 SARS-CoV-2 和 MPXV 中展示了能力,使该平台能够在未来病原体出现期间快速部署。

papers.title: Geospatial analysis and predictive modelling of mpox transmission hotspots: a case study of Ogun State, Nigeria
papers.abstract: Mpox is a recurring public health threat in Nigeria and was re-declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in August 2024. Nigeria's Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response system operates at the Local Government Area (LGA) level, yet published mpox risk models resolve risk only at state level, forcing uniform deployment across heterogeneous LGAs. This study developed and evaluated an LGA-resolution geospatial risk layer for the 20 LGAs of Ogun State and integrated it, as a proof of concept, into a live surveillance platform. State-level records of 40 laboratory-confirmed cases (NCDC, 2022) and 151 suspected cases (Ogun State Ministry of Health, 2022–2024), 191 in total, were spatially disaggregated into 189 pseudo-presence points and modelled with an ensemble of maximum entropy, random forest, and extreme gradient boosting over 100 bootstrap replicates. Discrimination was good under random hold-out (AUC 0.77; Boyce index 0.99) but fell under spatially blocked cross-validation (AUC 0.57), indicating that the layer is suited to coarse triage between tiers rather than within-tier ranking. Seven LGAs were classified high risk along a central corridor anchored on Abeokuta South and the Ijebu–Remo axis, six medium, and seven low. The tiered layer was exported as GeoJSON with tier-specific action packages and integrated into the IDS-Master platform as a proof-of-concept pathway from spatial epidemiology to routine public health surveillance. Because the 189 points were disaggregated from aggregate counts rather than individually geolocated, the tiers should be read as a spatial prior for triage rather than as confirmed case locations.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address the need for more precise mpox risk assessment at the Local Government Area (LGA) level in Nigeria, where current models operate at the state level. The researchers developed a geospatial risk layer for the 20 LGAs of Ogun State, integrating it into a live surveillance platform as a proof of concept. They used an ensemble of machine learning models to analyze 191 cases, spatially disaggregated into 189 pseudo-presence points. The model showed good discrimination under random hold-out but lower performance under spatially blocked cross-validation, suggesting it is suitable for tiered triage rather than within-tier ranking. Seven LGAs were classified as high risk, six as medium, and seven as low. The findings highlight the potential for refining public health interventions at the local level, though the evidence is moderate due to the reliance on aggregated data rather than individual case locations.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Mpox is a recurring public health threat in Nigeria and was re-declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in August 2024. Nigeria's Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response system operates at the Local Government Area (LGA) level, yet published mpox risk models resolve risk only at state level, forcing uniform deployment across heterogeneous LGAs.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This study developed and evaluated an LGA-resolution geospatial risk layer for the 20 LGAs of Ogun State and integrated it, as a proof of concept, into a live surveillance platform. State-level records of 40 laboratory-confirmed cases (NCDC, 2022) and 151 suspected cases (Ogun State Ministry of Health, 2022–2024), 191 in total, were spatially disaggregated into 189 pseudo-presence points and modelled with an ensemble of maximum entropy, random forest, and extreme gradient boosting over 100 bootstrap replicates.
analysis_en.methods: Because the 189 points were disaggregated from aggregate counts rather than individually geolocated, the tiers should be read as a spatial prior for triage rather than as confirmed case locations.
analysis_en.main_results: Discrimination was good under random hold-out (AUC 0.77; Boyce index 0.99) but fell under spatially blocked cross-validation (AUC 0.57), indicating that the layer is suited to coarse triage between tiers rather than within-tier ranking. Seven LGAs were classified high risk along a central corridor anchored on Abeokuta South and the Ijebu–Remo axis, six medium, and seven low.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The tiered layer was exported as GeoJSON with tier-specific action packages and integrated into the IDS-Master platform as a proof-of-concept pathway from spatial epidemiology to routine public health surveillance. The study provides a method for refining risk assessment at the LGA level, which could improve targeted public health interventions.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform more precise surveillance and response strategies at the local level, enhancing the ability to allocate resources effectively. This approach may serve as a model for other regions with similar epidemiological challenges.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's results indicate that the model performs well for coarse triage but may not be reliable for within-tier ranking, suggesting that further refinement and validation are needed. The evidence is moderate as it relies on spatially disaggregated data rather than individual case geolocation.

papers.title: Systematic Review of Mpox Outbreaks in Africa: Epidemiology, Transmission Dynamics, and Challenges
papers.abstract: Pendahuluan: Mpox, yang sebelumnya dikenal sebagai cacar monyet (monkeypox), telah muncul sebagai ancaman kesehatan masyarakat yang kian berkembang di seluruh Afrika. Ancaman ini ditandai dengan meningkatnya penularan antarmanusia, perluasan cakupan geografis, serta berbagai tantangan kesehatan masyarakat yang signifikan. Tinjauan sistematis ini bertujuan untuk menyintesis epidemiologi, dinamika penularan, dan tantangan sistemik terkait wabah Mpox di negara-negara Afrika. Metode: Pelaporan disusun berdasarkan pedoman PRISMA 2020. Pencarian studi dan laporan mengenai epidemiologi Mpox, tingkat kematian kasus (case fatality rate), serta respons kesehatan masyarakat dilakukan melalui PubMed dan sumber-sumber kelembagaan, termasuk WHO dan Africa CDC. Rentang waktu publikasi yang disertakan adalah 1 Januari 2020 hingga 31 Oktober 2024. Sebanyak enam sumber yang diterbitkan antara tahun 2022 dan 2024 dimasukkan dalam tinjauan ini. Temuan disintesis secara naratif. Hasil: WHO melaporkan 7.535 kasus terkonfirmasi di seluruh Afrika dari tanggal 1 Januari hingga 6 Oktober 2024, dengan 6.169 kasus di antaranya terjadi di Republik Demokratik Kongo (RDK). Bukti dari wilayah timur RDK menunjukkan adanya penularan antarmanusia yang berkelanjutan dari klad Ib. Laporan yang ditinjau mengidentifikasi adanya kesenjangan dalam deteksi kasus, kapasitas diagnostik, dan akses terhadap vaksin. Kesimpulan: Bukti yang ditinjau mendokumentasikan terjadinya penularan antarmanusia yang berkelanjutan pada wabah-wabah tertentu, serta kesenjangan yang substansial dalam kapasitas surveilans dan respons. Penguatan surveilans laboratorium, deteksi kasus, dan akses vaksin yang adil dapat mendukung upaya pengendalian wabah. Introduction: Mpox, formerly known as monkeypox, has emerged as a growing public health threat across Africa, characterized by increasing human-to-human transmission, geographic expansion, and significant public health challenges. This systematic review aimed to synthesize the epidemiology, transmission dynamics, and systemic challenges of Mpox outbreaks across African countries. Method: Reporting was guided by PRISMA 2020. PubMed and institutional sources, including WHO and Africa CDC, were searched for studies and reports on Mpox epidemiology, case fatality rates, and public health responses. The publication eligibility window was 1 January 2020 to 31 October 2024. Six sources published between 2022 and 2024 were included. Findings were synthesized narratively. Results: WHO reported 7,535 confirmed cases across Africa from 1 January to 6 October 2024, including 6,169 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Evidence from eastern DRC was consistent with sustained human-to-human transmission of clade Ib. The reviewed reports identified gaps in case detection, diagnostic capacity, and vaccine access. Conclusion: The reviewed evidence documents sustained human transmission in specific outbreaks and substantial gaps in surveillance and response capacity. Strengthening laboratory surveillance, case detection, and equitable vaccine access can support outbreak control.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 审查遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南。关于 猴痘 流行病学、病死率和公共卫生应对措施的研究和报告来自 PubMed 以及世界卫生组织和非洲疾病预防控制中心等机构来源。发表资格窗口为2020年1月1日至2024年10月31日。其中包括2022年至2024年期间发表的六个来源。调查结果以叙述方式综合。

papers.title: An accurate multiplex orthopoxvirus IgG panel for distinguishing vaccinated or exposed individuals from naïve individuals using machine-learning-guided feature selection.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Mpox, caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), has emerged as a major human orthopoxvirus (OPXV) disease in the post-smallpox-eradication era. Rapid, scalable serology that distinguishes immunologically naive individuals from those with prior OPXV vaccination or exposure is important for surveillance, outbreak response, and vaccine-program evaluation. The primary cross-sectional analysis included 229 de-identified human serum or plasma specimens provisionally classified as naive (born after 1972; n = 116), presumed smallpox-vaccinated (born before 1972; n = 89), or MPXV-exposed/infected (n = 24). Median fluorescence intensity (MFI) values were analyzed using partial least-squares discriminant analysis (PLS-DA) and Boruta/Random Forest feature selection under stratified nested cross-validation. Performance metrics included apparent sensitivity, apparent specificity, overall accuracy, area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC), and balanced accuracy. RESULTS: The 11-antigen profile broadly separated naive specimens from presumed smallpox-vaccinated and MPXV-exposed/infected specimens. Using per-antigen cutoffs derived from the presumed naive group, the highest apparent discrimination was observed for MPXV A35R, VARV A36R, VACV A33R, and MPXV B6R. Boruta/Random Forest analysis identified a compact five-antigen signature - MPXV A35R, VARV A36R, MPXV B6R, MPXV E8L, and VACV A33R - that achieved 89.52% overall accuracy and 83.07% balanced accuracy for three-class discrimination and 96.51% overall accuracy with 96.46% balanced accuracy for binary discrimination (naive vs. CONCLUSIONS: The selected five-antigen profile yielded 96.51% binary classification accuracy against the supplied cohort labels but does not establish clinical differentiation between vaccination and infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a rapid, scalable serology method to distinguish immunologically naive individuals from those with prior OPXV vaccination or exposure, addressing the need for accurate surveillance and outbreak response in the post-smallpox-eradication era.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional analysis included 229 human serum or plasma specimens, categorized as naive (born after 1972), presumed smallpox-vaccinated (born before 1972), or MPXV-exposed/infected.
analysis.methods: Serum specimens were analyzed using partial least-squares discriminant analysis (PLS-DA) and Boruta/Random Forest feature selection under stratified nested cross-validation.
analysis.main_results: The 11-antigen profile broadly separated naive specimens from presumed smallpox-vaccinated and MPXV-exposed/infected specimens. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The selected five-antigen profile yielded high binary classification accuracy but did not establish clinical differentiation between vaccination and infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在开发一种快速、可扩展的 血清学 方法,以区分免疫学上未接触过 OPXV 疫苗接种 或暴露过的个体,满足天花根除后时代对 监测 和 暴发 准确反应的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 横断面分析包括 229 份人类血清或血浆样本,分为原始样本(1972 年之后出生)、推测接种过天花疫苗的样本(1972 年之前出生)或 MPXV 暴露/感染样本。
elements_zh.methods: 使用偏最小二乘判别分析 (PLS-DA) 和分层嵌套交叉验证下的 Boruta/随机森林特征选择对血清样本进行分析。

analysis_en.methods: Serum specimens were analyzed using partial least-squares discriminant analysis (PLS-DA) and Boruta/Random Forest feature selection under stratified nested cross-validation.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Mpox, caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), has emerged as a major human orthopoxvirus (OPXV) disease in the post-smallpox-eradication era. Rapid, scalable serology that distinguishes immunologically naive individuals from those with prior OPXV vaccination or exposure is important for surveillance, outbreak response, and vaccine-program evaluation. The primary cross-sectional analysis included 229 de-identified human serum or plasma specimens provisionally classified as naive (born after 1972; n = 116), presumed smallpox-vaccinated (born before 1972; n = 89), or MPXV-exposed/infected (n = 24). Median fluorescence intensity (MFI) values were analyzed using partial least-squares discriminant analysis (PLS-DA) and Boruta/Random Forest feature selection under stratified nested cross-validation. Performance metrics included apparent sensitivity, apparent specificity, overall accuracy, area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC), and balanced accuracy. RESULTS: The 11-antigen profile broadly separated naive specimens from presumed smallpox-vaccinated and MPXV-exposed/infected specimens. Using per-antigen cutoffs derived from the presumed naive group, the highest apparent discrimination was observed for MPXV A35R, VARV A36R, VACV A33R, and MPXV B6R. Boruta/Random Forest analysis identified a compact five-antigen signature - MPXV A35R, VARV A36R, MPXV B6R, MPXV E8L, and VACV A33R - that achieved 89.52% overall accuracy and 83.07% balanced accuracy for three-class discrimination and 96.51% overall accuracy with 96.46% balanced accuracy for binary discrimination (naive vs. CONCLUSIONS: The selected five-antigen profile yielded 96.51% binary classification accuracy against the supplied cohort labels but does not establish clinical differentiation between vaccination and infection.

papers.title: A fractional order mpox transmission model with hygiene and vaccination pathways: Analysis and calibration to the 2024 mpox upsurge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo using weekly surveillance data from 2000 to 2024
papers.abstract: Mpox has emerged as a public health emergency of international concern, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) at the epicentre of sustained clade I transmission and the 2023–2024 clade Ib upsurge. We develop a seven compartment Caputo fractional order model (SHVEIQR: Susceptible, Hygiene practising, Vaccinated, Exposed, Infectious, Quarantined, Recovered) which couples direct person to person transmission with behavioural and medical intervention pathways. We establish well-posedness of the model, derive the control and basic reproduction numbers using the next generation method, and prove local and global asymptotic stability of the disease free equilibrium (DFE). A normalized forward sensitivity analysis identifies the transmission rate, quarantine rate, and, at high intervention coverage, the vaccine and hygiene efficacy parameters as the dominant drivers of the reproduction numbers. Using publicly reported weekly mpox case counts for the DRC, we calibrate the model to the artefact free accelerating phase of the 2024 upsurge (weeks 9 to 32 of 2024; the 2000 to 2024 series of 1302 weekly observations is used for data description and context, and the calibration window is a 24 week subset of that series). Using nonlinear least squares, we obtain a baseline reproduction number of 2.87 (bootstrap 95% CI [2.62,3.12]), consistent with the observed exponential growth. Numerical simulations use a fractional Adams–Bashforth–Moulton predictor corrector scheme validated against classical Runge–Kutta integration at integer order, and the fractional system is rendered dimensionally consistent by an explicit reference time scaling. We show that the memory index systematically delays and flattens the epidemic peak (these trajectories are sensitivity scenarios, the fractional order α is not identifiable from the available 24 point calibration window and is therefore not estimated), which combined vaccination and hygiene coverage of roughly 45% in each channel simultaneously pushes the control reproduction number below unity, and that quarantine scale up is, parameter-for-parameter, the single most effective lever available to public health authorities in a low vaccine access setting such as the DRC. Our results provide a transparent, data grounded, and reproducible guide for evaluating mpox control policy.

papers.title_zh: 具有卫生和 疫苗接种 路径的分数阶 猴痘 传播 模型:使用 2000 年至 2024 年每周 监测 数据对刚果民主共和国 2024 年 猴痘 热潮进行分析和校准
papers.source_body_en: Mpox has emerged as a public health emergency of international concern, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) at the epicentre of sustained clade I transmission and the 2023–2024 clade Ib upsurge. We develop a seven compartment Caputo fractional order model (SHVEIQR: Susceptible, Hygiene practising, Vaccinated, Exposed, Infectious, Quarantined, Recovered) which couples direct person to person transmission with behavioural and medical intervention pathways. We establish well-posedness of the model, derive the control and basic reproduction numbers using the next generation method, and prove local and global asymptotic stability of the disease free equilibrium (DFE). A normalized forward sensitivity analysis identifies the transmission rate, quarantine rate, and, at high intervention coverage, the vaccine and hygiene efficacy parameters as the dominant drivers of the reproduction numbers. Using publicly reported weekly mpox case counts for the DRC, we calibrate the model to the artefact free accelerating phase of the 2024 upsurge (weeks 9 to 32 of 2024; the 2000 to 2024 series of 1302 weekly observations is used for data description and context, and the calibration window is a 24 week subset of that series). Using nonlinear least squares, we obtain a baseline reproduction number of 2.87 (bootstrap 95% CI [2.62,3.12]), consistent with the observed exponential growth. Numerical simulations use a fractional Adams–Bashforth–Moulton predictor corrector scheme validated against classical Runge–Kutta integration at integer order, and the fractional system is rendered dimensionally consistent by an explicit reference time scaling. We show that the memory index systematically delays and flattens the epidemic peak (these trajectories are sensitivity scenarios, the fractional order α is not identifiable from the available 24 point calibration window and is therefore not estimated), which combined vaccination and hygiene coverage of roughly 45% in each channel simultaneously pushes the control reproduction number below unity, and that quarantine scale up is, parameter-for-parameter, the single most effective lever available to public health authorities in a low vaccine access setting such as the DRC. Our results provide a transparent, data grounded, and reproducible guide for evaluating mpox control policy.

papers.title: Mpox virus replication and drug resistance in the central nervous system of a man with advanced human immunodeficiency virus at autopsy
papers.abstract: Abstract Mpox virus (MPXV) clade IIb caused an outbreak of >100,000 cases globally, with highest disease burden in people living with advanced human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), those with CD4 count 3 . We performed an extensive autopsy on a fatal case of mpox in a man living with advanced HIV-1, who achieved HIV suppression but poor immune reconstitution despite > 6 months antiretroviral therapy and had progressive necrotizing mucocutaneous mpox disease despite multiple prolonged mpox-targeted therapies. We quantified MPXV DNA across 76 autopsy samples from different anatomical sites and observed a high burden in skin and mucosal tissue and a lower burden in all central nervous system (CNS) tissues tested. However, we detected replication-competent MPXV in multiple CNS tissues and confirmed neuronal and glial cell infection using RNA-scope in situ hybridization. MPXV sequencing from body and brain tissues revealed widespread tecovirimat resistance-associated variants. This case proves that replication-competent MPXV and tecovirimat resistance-associated isolates can infect and persist in the CNS of people with advanced HIV thus informing future therapeutic design.

We quantified MPXV DNA across 76 autopsy samples from different anatomical sites and observed a high burden in skin and mucosal tissue and a lower burden in all central nervous system (CNS) tissues tested. However, we detected replication-competent MPXV in multiple CNS tissues and confirmed neuronal and glial cell infection using RNA-scope in situ hybridization. MPXV sequencing from body and brain tissues revealed widespread tecovirimat resistance-associated variants. This case proves that replication-competent MPXV and tecovirimat resistance-associated isolates can infect and persist in the CNS of people with advanced HIV thus informing future therapeutic design.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of mpox virus (MPXV) clade IIb on a man with advanced HIV-1, who had achieved HIV suppression but poor immune reconstitution. An extensive autopsy was performed, revealing high MPXV DNA levels in skin and mucosal tissues and replication-competent virus in multiple central nervous system (CNS) tissues. The findings highlight the need for targeted therapeutic strategies in such populations. The study's single-case design limits generalizability, but the detailed molecular analysis provides strong evidence of MPXV's ability to affect the CNS in advanced HIV. This case contributes to understanding mpox virus pathogenesis and informs future therapeutic approaches.

papers.title: HYDRA-YOLOv10: An automated approach for detection and classification of Monkeypox skin lesion stages using YOLOv10 Adapted with Circular-Responsive Attention (CRA) and Normalization-Based Attention Mechanism (NAM)
papers.abstract: Abstract Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease whose clinical manifestations often resemble other dermatological conditions, making accurate and timely diagnosis a challenge. Traditional diagnostic methods, such as PCR, are accurate but costly, time-consuming, and often inaccessible in low-resource environments. This study proposes HYDRA-YOLOv10, a deep learning-based architecture designed to automatically detect and classify Mpox skin lesions across five clinical stages: macules, papules, vesicles, pustules, and scabs. The model incorporates key architectural innovations, including hybrid backbone connections, extended use of the C2f module for multi-scale feature fusion, and the replacement of the SPPF module with the Circular-Responsive Attention (CRA) mechanism-designed to better capture the geometry of rounded lesions using polar-aware convolutions. Additionally, the Normalization-based Attention Mechanism (NAM) replaces conventional spatial attention, enhancing feature integration and robustness to visual variations. Experimental results demonstrate the model’s superiority over state-of-the-art approaches, achieving 95.4% precision, 94.8% recall, 95.1% F1 score, 95.5% mAP@0.5, and 83.4% mAP@0.5:0.95. These results validate HYDRA-YOLOv10 as a reliable and scalable solution for automated Mpox diagnosis, offering valuable support for clinical decision-making and public health response.

papers.title_zh: HYDRA-YOLOv10:使用 YOLOv10 检测和分类猴痘皮肤病变阶段的自动化方法,采用循环响应注意力 (CRA) 和基于标准化的注意力机制 (NAM)
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease whose clinical manifestations often resemble other dermatological conditions, making accurate and timely diagnosis a challenge. Traditional diagnostic methods, such as PCR, are accurate but costly, time-consuming, and often inaccessible in low-resource environments. This study proposes HYDRA-YOLOv10, a deep learning-based architecture designed to automatically detect and classify Mpox skin lesions across five clinical stages: macules, papules, vesicles, pustules, and scabs. The model incorporates key architectural innovations, including hybrid backbone connections, extended use of the C2f module for multi-scale feature fusion, and the replacement of the SPPF module with the Circular-Responsive Attention (CRA) mechanism-designed to better capture the geometry of rounded lesions using polar-aware convolutions. Additionally, the Normalization-based Attention Mechanism (NAM) replaces conventional spatial attention, enhancing feature integration and robustness to visual variations. Experimental results demonstrate the model’s superiority over state-of-the-art approaches, achieving 95.4% precision, 94.8% recall, 95.1% F1 score, 95.5% mAP@0.5, and 83.4% mAP@0.5:0.95. These results validate HYDRA-YOLOv10 as a reliable and scalable solution for automated Mpox diagnosis, offering valuable support for clinical decision-making and public health response.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 猴痘 是一种人畜共患的病毒性疾病,其临床表现通常与其他皮肤病相似,这使得准确、及时的 诊断 成为一个挑战。传统的诊断方法(例如 PCR)准确,但成本高昂、耗时,并且在资源匮乏的环境中通常无法使用。这项研究提出了 HYDRA-YOLOv10,这是一种基于深度学习的架构,旨在自动检测和分类 猴痘 五个临床阶段的皮肤病变:斑疹、丘疹、水疱、脓疱和结痂。该模型融合了关键的架构创新,包括混合主干连接、扩展使用 C2f 模块进行多尺度特征融合,以及用圆形响应注意力 (CRA) 机制替换 SPPF 模块,旨在使用极感知卷积更好地捕获圆形病变的几何形状。此外,基于归一化的注意力机制(NAM)取代了传统的空间注意力,增强了特征集成和对视觉变化的鲁棒性。实验结果证明该模型优于最先进的方法,实现了 95.4% 的精度、94.8% 的召回率、95.1% F1 分数、95.5% mAP@0.5 和 83.4% mAP@0.5:0.95。这些结果验证了 HYDRA-YOLOv10 作为自动化 猴痘 诊断 的可靠且可扩展的解决方案,为临床决策和公共卫生响应提供宝贵的支持。

papers.title: Healthcare Workers’ Preparedness for Monkeypox Pandemic Response in SubSaharan Africa: A Rapid Review Investigating the Knowledge Gap
papers.abstract: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.
papers.journal: Journal of Clinical Virology and Translational Research

papers.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区医护人员应对猴痘大流行的准备情况:快速回顾调查知识差距
papers.source_body_en: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.

papers.title: Comparative Performance of CNN and HOG-LBP-Based SVM for Mpox Classification
papers.abstract: Skin lesions caused by mpox may visually resemble those resulting from other skin diseases, making image-based classification a potential approach to support preliminary screening. This study aimed to compare the performance of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and a Support Vector Machine (SVM) using combined Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) and Local Binary Patterns (LBP) features for binary classification of mpox and other skin lesion images. The experimental dataset consisted of 224 unique original images, comprising 116 mpox images and 108 images of other conditions, including chickenpox and measles. The SVM employed a 23,250-dimensional HOG-LBP feature vector with a Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel, whereas the CNN automatically learned visual representations from preprocessed RGB images. Both models were evaluated using identical stratified five-fold cross-validation partitions, with data splitting performed before augmentation and hyperparameter tuning conducted within the training partitions. Performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and specificity. The CNN achieved an average accuracy of 84.37%, precision of 88.73%, recall of 80.25%, F1-score of 84.06%, and specificity of 88.92%. Meanwhile, the SVM achieved 83.03%, 84.87%, 81.92%, 83.32%, and 84.28%, respectively. The results indicate that the CNN achieved higher performance in four evaluation metrics, while the SVM obtained slightly higher recall. These findings demonstrate that both approaches offer different classification strengths within the evaluated dataset. Nevertheless, further evaluation using independent datasets and more diverse skin lesion images is necessary to assess their generalizability before potential application in preliminary mpox screening.

The experimental dataset consisted of 224 unique original images, comprising 116 mpox images and 108 images of other conditions, including chickenpox and measles. The SVM employed a 23,250-dimensional HOG-LBP feature vector with a Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel, whereas the CNN automatically learned visual representations from preprocessed RGB images. Both models were evaluated using identical stratified five-fold cross-validation partitions, with data splitting performed before augmentation and hyperparameter tuning conducted within the training partitions. Performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and specificity. The CNN achieved an average accuracy of 84.37%, precision of 88.73%, recall of 80.25%, F1-score of 84.06%, and specificity of 88.92%. Meanwhile, the SVM achieved 83.03%, 84.87%, 81.92%, 83.32%, and 84.28%, respectively. The results indicate that the CNN achieved higher performance in four evaluation metrics, while the SVM obtained slightly higher recall. These findings demonstrate that both approaches offer different classification strengths within the evaluated dataset. Nevertheless, further evaluation using independent datasets and more diverse skin lesion images is necessary to assess their generalizability before potential application in preliminary mpox screening.

papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘 引起的皮肤病变在视觉上可能类似于其他皮肤病引起的皮肤病变,这使得基于图像的分类成为支持初步筛查的潜在方法。本研究旨在比较卷积神经网络 (CNN) 和支持 媒介 机器 (SVM) 的性能,使用组合的定向梯度直方图 (HOG) 和局部二值模式 (LBP) 特征对 猴痘 和其他皮肤病变图像进行二元分类。实验数据集由 224 张独特的原始图像组成,其中包括 116 张 猴痘 图像和 108 张其他疾病的图像,包括水痘和麻疹。SVM 采用具有径向基函数 (RBF) 内核的 23,250 维 HOG-LBP 特征 媒介,而 CNN 自动从预处理的 RGB 图像中学习视觉表示。两种模型都使用相同的分层五重交叉验证分区进行评估,在训练分区内进行增强和超参数调整之前执行数据分割。使用准确度、精确度、召回率、F1 分数和特异性来评估性能。CNN 的平均准确度为 84.37%,精确度为 88.73%,召回率为 80.25%,F1 得分为 84.06%,特异性为 88.92%。同时,SVM 的准确率分别为 83.03%、84.87%、81.92%、83.32% 和 84.28%。结果表明,CNN 在四个评估指标上取得了较高的性能,而 SVM 获得了稍高的召回率。这些发现表明,两种方法在评估的数据集中提供不同的分类强度。然而,在初步 猴痘 筛选中潜在应用之前,有必要使用独立数据集和更多样化的皮肤病变图像进行进一步评估,以评估其普遍性。

papers.title: Accuracy of CRISPR-Cas-based nucleic acid detection for Mpox Virus a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Mpox is an emerging and re-emerging infectious disease caused by the monkeypox virus (MPXV), posing an ongoing threat to global public health. Early, rapid, and accurate detection of MPXV is essential for timely diagnosis, appropriate clinical management, and effective outbreak prevention and control. Quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) is widely used as the reference method for MPXV nucleic acid detection. However, its dependence on specialized equipment, trained personnel, and laboratory infrastructure limits its accessibility in resource-limited settings and point-of-care testing (POCT) applications.​ In recent years, clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR)-associated (Cas) systems have emerged as promising molecular diagnostic platforms owing to their high specificity, programmability, rapid detection capabilities, and potential for integration with isothermal nucleic acid amplification technologies. Various CRISPR-Cas-based assays, including Cas12- and Cas13-mediated detection systems, have been developed for MPXV detection. Although individual studies have reported encouraging diagnostic performance, their findings vary in terms of sensitivity, specificity, amplification strategies, detection formats, and clinical validation methods. Therefore, a comprehensive systematic review and meta-analysis is needed to quantitatively evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of CRISPR-Cas-based nucleic acid detection methods for MPXV and to investigate potential sources of heterogeneity.

papers.title: Integration of Mpox Prevention and Vaccination into HIV and Sexual Health Services: A Scoping Review Protocol
papers.abstract: Background: Mpox continues to pose challenges to public health systems, particularly regarding equitable access to vaccination, early diagnosis, and prevention services. HIV and sexual health services have played important roles in the mpox response, offering opportunities to incorporate vaccination, risk assessment, diagnostic testing, and other preventive interventions into established healthcare pathways. However, evidence concerning how these services have been integrated, their implementation outcomes, and their implications for health equity remains fragmented. Objective: To map and characterize models integrating mpox prevention and vaccination into HIV and sexual health services worldwide, and to identify reported implementation outcomes, barriers, facilitators, and equity-related implications. Methods: This scoping review will follow the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) methodological guidance. The review question and eligibility criteria will be structured using the Population–Concept–Context framework. Searches will be conducted in MEDLINE via PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, CINAHL, and LILACS, supplemented by grey literature searches and reference screening. Empirical studies and operational reports published from January 2022 onward will be considered without language restrictions. Two reviewers will independently screen records and extract data using a standardized instrument. Findings will be synthesized through descriptive numerical summaries, structured evidence mapping, and qualitative content analysis. Implementation outcomes will be organized using the conceptual framework proposed by Proctor and colleagues. The completed review will be reported according to PRISMA-ScR. Expected contribution: The review will identify how mpox prevention and vaccination have been operationally integrated into HIV and sexual health services, characterize the populations reached, document implementation challenges, and highlight evidence gaps relevant to sustainable and equitable service delivery.

papers.title_zh: 将 猴痘 预防和 疫苗接种 纳入艾滋病毒和性健康服务:范围界定审查方案
papers.source_body_en: Background: Mpox continues to pose challenges to public health systems, particularly regarding equitable access to vaccination, early diagnosis, and prevention services. HIV and sexual health services have played important roles in the mpox response, offering opportunities to incorporate vaccination, risk assessment, diagnostic testing, and other preventive interventions into established healthcare pathways. However, evidence concerning how these services have been integrated, their implementation outcomes, and their implications for health equity remains fragmented. Objective: To map and characterize models integrating mpox prevention and vaccination into HIV and sexual health services worldwide, and to identify reported implementation outcomes, barriers, facilitators, and equity-related implications. Methods: This scoping review will follow the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) methodological guidance. The review question and eligibility criteria will be structured using the Population–Concept–Context framework. Searches will be conducted in MEDLINE via PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, CINAHL, and LILACS, supplemented by grey literature searches and reference screening. Empirical studies and operational reports published from January 2022 onward will be considered without language restrictions. Two reviewers will independently screen records and extract data using a standardized instrument. Findings will be synthesized through descriptive numerical summaries, structured evidence mapping, and qualitative content analysis. Implementation outcomes will be organized using the conceptual framework proposed by Proctor and colleagues. The completed review will be reported according to PRISMA-ScR. Expected contribution: The review will identify how mpox prevention and vaccination have been operationally integrated into HIV and sexual health services, characterize the populations reached, document implementation challenges, and highlight evidence gaps relevant to sustainable and equitable service delivery.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘 继续对公共卫生系统构成挑战,特别是在公平获得 疫苗接种、早期 诊断 和预防服务方面。HIV 和性健康服务在 猴痘 应对措施中发挥了重要作用,提供了将 猴痘、风险评估、诊断测试和其他预防干预措施纳入已建立的医疗保健途径的机会。然而,关于这些服务如何整合、其实施结果及其对健康公平的影响的证据仍然支离破碎。目标:绘制和描述将 猴痘 预防和 疫苗接种 纳入全球艾滋病毒和性健康服务的模型,并确定报告的实施结果、障碍、促进因素和公平相关影响。方法:本次范围界定审查将遵循乔安娜·布里格斯研究所 (JBI) 的方法学指导。审查问题和资格标准将使用人口-概念-背景框架来构建。检索将通过 PubMed、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science、CINAHL 和 LILACS 在 MEDLINE 中进行,并辅以灰色文献检索和参考文献筛选。自 2022 年 1 月起发布的实证研究和运营报告将受到考虑,不受语言限制。两名评审员将使用标准化仪器独立筛选记录并提取数据。研究结果将通过描述性数字摘要、结构化证据映射和定性内容分析来综合。将使用 Proctor 及其同事提出的概念框架来组织实施结果。已完成的审查将根据 PRISMA-ScR 进行报告。预期贡献:审查将确定 猴痘 预防和 疫苗接种 如何在操作上纳入艾滋病毒和性健康服务,描述所覆盖人群的特征,记录实施挑战,并强调与可持续和公平服务提供相关的证据差距。

papers.full_text:
Abstract A data-driven SEIR model is proposed to investigate the transmission dynamics of monkeypox. The susceptible population is divided into aware and unaware classes to capture behavioral changes that affect disease spread, while a saturated treatment function captures healthcare capacity limitations during outbreaks. Model parameters are estimated using demographic and epidemiological data, along with least-squares curve fitting based on reported monkeypox cases in the USA. The basic reproduction number \(R_0\) is derived using the next-generation matrix approach, and the local stability of disease-free and endemic equilibria is analyzed. Bifurcation analysis reveals that variations in awareness and treatment capacity can significantly alter disease dynamics and induce qualitative transitions in system behavior. Sensitivity analysis identifies the key parameters that influence \(R_0\) and the spread of infection. Furthermore, optimal control strategies involving vaccination and isolation are implemented to minimize infection prevalence and intervention costs. Numerical simulations demonstrate that increased awareness and timely interventions effectively reduce disease burden and improve outbreak control. Similar content being viewed by others Data Availability All of the authors state that all data generated or analyzed during this study are included in this article. The manuscript has associated data in a data repository. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract A data-driven SEIR model is proposed to investigate the transmission dynamics of monkeypox. The susceptible population is divided into aware and unaware classes to capture behavioral changes that affect disease spread, while a saturated treatment function captures healthcare capacity limitations during outbreaks. Model parameters are estimated using demographic and epidemiological data, along with least-squares curve fitting based on reported monkeypox cases in the USA. The basic reproduction number \(R_0\) is derived using the next-generation matrix approach, and the local stability of disease-free and endemic equilibria is analyzed. Bifurcation analysis reveals that variations in awareness and treatment capacity can significantly alter disease dynamics and induce qualitative transitions in system behavior. Sensitivity analysis identifies the key parameters that influence \(R_0\) and the spread of infection. Furthermore, optimal control strategies involving vaccination and isolation are implemented to minimize infection prevalence and intervention costs. Numerical simulations demonstrate that increased awareness and timely interventions effectively reduce disease burden and improve outbreak control. The manuscript has associated data in a data repository.
