news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Monday, November 23, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Health Global Mpox Prevalence Among Men Who Have Sex With Men Reached 2.30 Percent by November 19, 2026 in Health Reading Time: 7 mins read 0 Global Mpox Prevalence Among Men Who Have Sex With Men Reached 2.30 Percent Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram A comprehensive systematic review and meta-analysis published in the journal Infectious Diseases of Poverty has established that the pooled prevalence of mpox infection among men who have sex with men worldwide was 2.30 percent during the multi-country outbreak period. Led by researchers Luqiu Tao, Yanzheng Zou, Lilei Wang, and Wei Wang, the global research synthesis evaluated twenty-eight eligible investigations comprising 46,598 participants from men who have sex with men communities and 1,274 confirmed mpox cases spanning fifteen countries. Across the individual primary studies, observed infection proportions varied substantially, spanning from 0.00 percent to a peak of 16.31 percent. The authors performed quantitative pooling using a random-effects statistical model after detecting significant between-study heterogeneity, with an I-squared statistic of 97.3 percent, a tau-squared of 0.0091, and a Cochran Q test yielding a p-value below 0.0001. Applying the Freeman-Tukey double arcsine transformation to normalize proportional data, the researchers calculated an overall pooled mpox infection prevalence of 2.30 percent, bounded by a ninety-five percent confidence interval ranging from 1.29 percent to 3.57 percent. Normality of these transformed proportions was confirmed using the Shapiro-Wilk test, which returned a statistic of 0.936 and a p-value of 0.087, verifying that the aggregated analytical framework adhered to standard statistical assumptions while capturing the overall disease burden across international peer-reviewed literature. The historical and epidemiological context supporting this investigation traces back to the emergence of mpox, an infectious zoonotic condition caused by the monkeypox virus that was first identified in a human patient in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 1970. Although the virus historically caused sporadic endemic outbreaks largely confined to forested zones of central and western Africa, the epidemiological presentation transformed radically during the 2022 to 2024 global resurgence. During this event, sustained human-to-human transmission was predominantly sustained through sexual contact within men who have sex with men networks, driven primarily by the Clade IIb viral lineage. The World Health Organization declared the multi-country spread a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in July 2022 after infections expanded rapidly across non-endemic territories in Europe and North America through close physical and mucosal contact. Although Clade IIb generally produces milder clinical illness and lower fatality than historical Clade I lineages, it still resulted in severe complications, painful mucosal lesions, and widespread hospitalizations. A second international emergency was subsequently declared in August 2024 following the surge and cross-border dissemination of the more transmissible Clade Ib lineage originating from Central Africa, which coincided with the re-emergence of Clade IIb cases in Nigeria and South Africa. Discover more Get Tested Browse Magazines men To rigorously aggregate published evidence regarding mpox burdens in this heavily affected demographic, the research team designed their systematic review in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines and formally registered the analytical protocol on the PROSPERO international database under registration number CRD42024587173. The investigators performed exhaustive literature searches across five prominent medical and scientific databases, namely PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, the China National Knowledge Infrastructure, and Wanfang Data, spanning from database inception through December 16, 2024. Search queries combined established medical subject headings and free-text terms covering monkeypox virus designations alongside terminology identifying gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men networks. The inclusion criteria required that studies be published in English or Chinese, provide explicit numbers of mpox cases and overall sample denominators among men who have sex with men, establish confirmed diagnoses through either laboratory testing or formal self-report, and capture observational periods following the introduction of initial cases. Non-primary literature including narrative reviews, isolated case reports, and studies lacking explicit numerator or denominator data were excluded during screening. Discover more Check Symptoms Read Med Journals Track Fertility Support Pride The study selection process initiated with 2,414 retrieved records, from which duplicate entries were eliminated, leaving 1,606 unique publications to undergo initial title and abstract screening. Of these, 1,479 non-pertinent reports were set aside, allowing 127 articles to advance to full-text assessment. Following rigorous evaluation against predefined exclusion criteria, ninety-nine records were eliminated, leaving twenty-eight primary studies published between 2022 and 2024 that satisfied all methodological conditions for quantitative synthesis. Methodological quality was evaluated using validated instruments tailored to observational research designs, specifically utilizing the American Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality eleven-item tool for cross-sectional studies and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale for cohort and case-control formats. Across the twenty-eight analyzed investigations, twenty-three studies met the criteria for moderate methodological quality, encompassing twenty cross-sectional papers and three longitudinal or case-control reports, while five cross-sectional publications achieved high quality scores. Sensitivity analysis restricted strictly to the five high-quality investigations yielded a pooled prevalence of 1.91 percent with a ninety-five percent confidence interval from 0.49 to 4.20 percent, which remained statistically comparable to the overall cohort finding of 2.30 percent. Geographic and participant recruitment characteristics varied considerably across the final collection of twenty-eight publications, illustrating diverse research settings across fifteen countries. Europe accounted for the largest volume of publications with sixteen investigations, spanning Austria, Belgium, Denmark, France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Spain, and the United Kingdom. Asia contributed seven studies from China and Japan, alongside single investigations from Canada and Israel, while North America supplied three studies and South America provided two investigations, both based in Brazil. Twenty-one investigations were conducted in nations classified as high-income economies by the World Bank, whereas the remaining seven studies took place in upper-middle-income countries. Regarding recruitment venues, twelve studies enrolled individuals visiting dedicated sexual health clinics, nine engaged participants through online social media platforms, three examined pre-existing cohorts related to men who have sex with men, and four utilized mixed recruitment channels. Notably, all twenty-eight included studies employed non-probability sampling methods: twenty-three relied on convenience sampling, three used purposive sampling, and two utilized combined convenience and snowball recruitment approaches to reach eligible study participants. Subgroup analyses stratified by continental geography uncovered striking spatial disparities in infection burden that represented the primary source of variance across the international literature. Men who have sex with men surveyed in South America exhibited a pooled mpox prevalence of 9.58 percent, with a ninety-five percent confidence interval between 2.71 and 20.01 percent, which was substantially higher than the 2.40 percent observed in Europe, the 1.87 percent recorded in North America, and the 1.14 percent reported across Asian studies. The absolute risk difference between South America and Asia reached 8.4 percent, with a ninety-five percent confidence interval of 7.7 to 9.2 percent, translating to an excess burden of eighty-four cases per 1,000 individuals. Absolute risk differences between South America and Europe reached 7.2 percent, while Europe compared to Asia displayed an absolute difference of 1.3 percent. In univariable meta-regression modeling, geographic continent emerged as the single largest contributor to study heterogeneity, accounting for 22.24 percent of between-study variance with a statistically significant p-value of 0.02. Primary sampling methodology also explained 10.69 percent of variance in univariable testing, whereas economic classification, diagnostic criteria, and study quality scores showed no meaningful statistical associations. Multivariable meta-regression confirmed that continental setting remained an independent predictor of mpox prevalence even after statistically adjusting for participant sampling methodologies. The multivariable regression model demonstrated overall significance, yielding an omnibus test statistic of 12.53 across five degrees of freedom with a p-value of 0.028, jointly accounting for 24.81 percent of the total between-study heterogeneity. Within this adjusted framework, the elevated prevalence in South America relative to Asia retained statistical significance, exhibiting a regression coefficient beta of 0.168, a ninety-five percent confidence interval from 0.028 to 0.309, and a p-value of 0.019. In contrast, specific sampling modalities did not maintain independent statistical significance in the adjusted multivariable model. The researchers noted that while regional prevalence differed sharply, other analyzed covariates exhibited minimal divergence. Subgroup comparisons across epidemic timing demonstrated that studies carried out in 2022 showed a pooled prevalence of 2.89 percent compared to 1.21 percent in investigations conducted during 2023, reflecting global outbreak deceleration, although this temporal difference did not reach formal statistical significance with a p-value of 0.06. Counterintuitively, subgroup stratifications based on perceived behavioral or clinical vulnerability revealed no statistically significant differences in mpox prevalence when compared against broader cohorts. Ten studies specifically examined high-risk populations, categorized by human immunodeficiency virus infection, pre-exposure prophylaxis utilization, concurrent sexually transmitted infections, or active high-risk sexual practices such as chemsex or multiple concurrent sexual partners. Within these high-risk groups, the pooled prevalence was 1.88 percent, with a ninety-five percent confidence interval of 0.22 to 4.73 percent, which was slightly lower than the 2.50 percent observed in general community recruitment, exhibiting no statistically significant variance with a p-value of 0.79 and an absolute risk difference of negative 0.62 percent. Similarly, eight studies evaluated asymptomatic participants who reported no mpox-compatible symptoms at the time of screening; this asymptomatic group showed an infection prevalence of 1.28 percent, ranging from 0.10 to 3.33 percent, compared to 2.71 percent among general study groups, with a non-significant p-value of 0.34. Clinical recruitment venues also yielded a modest 1.40 percent prevalence compared to 3.68 percent via online networks and 4.36 percent within established research cohorts. The authors discussed several epidemiological and behavioral dynamics that could account for why clinically designated high-risk groups did not exhibit higher infection rates in cross-sectional testing. They highlighted the prevention paradox, wherein individuals recognized as high risk often maintain deeper engagement with dedicated sexual health clinics and specialized care infrastructure. In the analyzed dataset, seven of the ten studies investigating high-risk groups were situated in countries with established mpox vaccine availability, and participants were predominantly drawn from clinical cohorts with routine medical linkages. Frequent healthcare interaction fosters elevated health literacy, regular diagnostic screening, and rapid access to preventive interventions, including smallpox-derived vaccines such as ACAM2000, MVA-BN, LC16m8, and OrthopoxVac. This proactive engagement likely facilitated earlier diagnosis and prompt isolation, thereby reducing point prevalence during cross-sectional surveys. Conversely, community and online recruitment across general populations captured broader, less clinically connected networks where unrecognized or milder infections could persist undetected before formal assessment. The synthesis also addressed methodological challenges regarding asymptomatic transmission and diagnostic criteria. Across fifteen studies confirming mpox through laboratory diagnostics such as polymerase chain reaction or serological assays, pooled prevalence was 2.24 percent, which was indistinguishable from the overall 2.30 percent estimate that included thirteen studies relying on verified self-reported diagnoses, yielding a subgroup comparison p-value of 0.96. Addressing asymptomatic cohorts, the authors noted that single-time-point cross-sectional surveys inherently struggle to differentiate true asymptomatic infection from pre-symptomatic viral shedding, as multiple participants in cited screening trials subsequently developed clinical manifestations after their initial positive test. Funnel plot symmetry, supported by Egger regression testing with a p-value of 0.57 and Begg rank correlation with a p-value of 0.68, indicated an absence of notable publication bias. Furthermore, leave-one-out sensitivity testing confirmed that no single primary study exerted disproportionate leverage over the pooled results. Despite the robustness of the quantitative synthesis, the authors underscored critical limitations inherent to the underlying evidence base. First, the ecological nature of aggregated meta-regression precludes inferring individual-level risk factors from population-level continental associations. Second, the multivariable model left substantial residual heterogeneity unexplained, indicating that local sexual network configurations, precise community stigma levels, and micro-epidemic curves remained unmeasured. Third, geographic coverage was notably unbalanced, with South American findings originating exclusively from two Brazilian investigations and no studies identified from the African continent or Oceania. Fourth, primary studies lacked systematic reporting of viral clades, meaning the synthesis predominantly reflects the 2022 to 2024 Clade IIb pandemic rather than the evolving dynamics of Clade Ib. Finally, HIV clinical markers such as CD4 counts and viral loads were inconsistently documented across primary cohorts. The authors concluded that future outbreak management requires geographically prioritized resource allocation and standardized surveillance metrics to monitor shifting viral transmission patterns effectively. Similarly, eight studies evaluated asymptomatic participants who reported no mpox-compatible symptoms at the time of screening; this asymptomatic group showed an infection prevalence of 1.28 percent, ranging from 0.10 to 3.33 percent, compared to 2.71 percent among general study groups, with a non-significant p-value of 0.34. Clinical recruitment venues also yielded a modest 1.40 percent prevalence compared to 3.68 percent via online networks and 4.36 percent within established research cohorts. The authors discussed several epidemiological and behavioral dynamics that could account for why clinically designated high-risk groups did not exhibit higher infection rates in cross-sectional testing. They highlighted the prevention paradox, wherein individuals recognized as high risk often maintain deeper engagement with dedicated sexual health clinics and specialized care infrastructure. In the analyzed dataset, seven of the ten studies investigating high-risk groups were situated in countries with established mpox vaccine availability, and participants were predominantly drawn from clinical cohorts with routine medical linkages. Frequent healthcare interaction fosters elevated health literacy, regular diagnostic screening, and rapid access to preventive interventions, including smallpox-derived vaccines such as ACAM2000, MVA-BN, LC16m8, and OrthopoxVac. This proactive engagement likely facilitated earlier diagnosis and prompt isolation, thereby reducing point prevalence during cross-sectional surveys. Conversely, community and online recruitment across general populations captured broader, less clinically connected networks where unrecognized or milder infections could persist undetected before formal assessment. The synthesis also addressed methodological challenges regarding asymptomatic transmission and diagnostic criteria. Across fifteen studies confirming mpox through laboratory diagnostics such as polymerase chain reaction or serological assays, pooled prevalence was 2.24 percent, which was indistinguishable from the overall 2.30 percent estimate that included thirteen studies relying on verified self-reported diagnoses, yielding a subgroup comparison p-value of 0.96. Addressing asymptomatic cohorts, the authors noted that single-time-point cross-sectional surveys inherently struggle to differentiate true asymptomatic infection from pre-symptomatic viral shedding, as multiple participants in cited screening trials subsequently developed clinical manifestations after their initial positive test. Funnel plot symmetry, supported by Egger regression testing with a p-value of 0.57 and Begg rank correlation with a p-value of 0.68, indicated an absence of notable publication bias. Furthermore, leave-one-out sensitivity testing confirmed that no single primary study exerted disproportionate leverage over the pooled results. Despite the robustness of the quantitative synthesis, the authors underscored critical limitations inherent to the underlying evidence base. First, the ecological nature of aggregated meta-regression precludes inferring individual-level risk factors from population-level continental associations. Second, the multivariable model left substantial residual heterogeneity unexplained, indicating that local sexual network configurations, precise community stigma levels, and micro-epidemic curves remained unmeasured. Third, geographic coverage was notably unbalanced, with South American findings originating exclusively from two Brazilian investigations and no studies identified from the African continent or Oceania. Fourth, primary studies lacked systematic reporting of viral clades, meaning the synthesis predominantly reflects the 2022 to 2024 Clade IIb pandemic rather than the evolving dynamics of Clade Ib. Finally, HIV clinical markers such as CD4 counts and viral loads were inconsistently documented across primary cohorts. The authors concluded that future outbreak management requires geographically prioritized resource allocation and standardized surveillance metrics to monitor shifting viral transmission patterns effectively. analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The pooled prevalence of mpox infection among men who have sex with men was 2.30 percent, with a 95% confidence interval of 1.29 to 3.57 percent. The findings were based on 28 primary studies published between 2022 and 2024, with some limitations in explaining residual heterogeneity.

news.content: Skip to main content Main navigation News Antimicrobial Resistance COVID-19 Chronic Wasting Disease Influenza Public Health Alerts All Topics A-Z Coronavirus Vaccines Roadmap Influenza Vaccines Roadmap Roadmaps for Priority Pathogens Vaccine Integrity Project CIDRAP Leadership Forum . . Topics & Projects Antimicrobial Stewardship Chronic Wasting Disease Osterholm Update Podcasts Newsletters About CIDRAP CIDRAP in the News Our Staff Our Director Osterholm in the Press Shop Merchandise Contact Us About Search CLOSE Search Support Menu As mpox continues to circulate, US adults’ awareness of the virus has plummeted since 2022 Laine Bergeson Mpox Jacob Wackerhausen / iStock Share Copied to clipboard Four years after a large global mpox outbreak, Americans’ awareness of the viral illness has dropped significantly, according to a survey today from the Annenberg Public Policy Center (APPC) at the University of Pennsylvania. Of the 1,842 US adults surveyed from September 22 to October 5, 2026, only 8% said they had seen, read, or heard anything about mpox in the past month. That number is down from 11% in July 2024—and down 80% in July 2022. While case counts have dropped nationwide over the past four years, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) says that “ongoing, low-level transmission has persisted,” which indicates “a transition toward endemic circulation.” Mpox is transmitted by close contact with the scabs, rashes, or bodily fluids of an infected person. It can also be spread by contact with the clothing, bedding, towels, and dishes of an infected person. Sexual transmission is a common route. Less than half know about mpox vaccine Roughly three-quarters (76%) of respondents said they are "not too familiar" or “not at all familiar” with mpox, and just 7% said they are “somewhat” or “very worried” about contracting it in the next three months. That number is significantly lower than the percentage of people (21%) who said they were worried about contracting it in August 2022. Almost two-thirds (62%) said they were unsure about the contagiousness of mpox, and only 18% correctly said it is less contagious than COVID-19. In August 2022, 41% said they knew it was less contagious than COVID. About half (49%) of survey respondents said they know how mpox is spread, while 51% recognized that face-to-face contact with an infected person increases the risk of infection. Those numbers are relatively unchanged from 2024. As the epidemiology of mpox changes, public understanding of who is at risk, how the virus spreads, and how vaccination can protect against it needs to keep pace. Knowledge about the mpox vaccine has dropped since August 2022, when 61% of people said they were aware that an mpox vaccine exists. Last month, less than half (44%) said they knew about the existence of an mpox vaccine. Forty-eight percent were unsure whether a vaccine exists. “The persistence of these knowledge gaps matters because the virus has not stood still,” says APPC’s managing director of survey research, Ken Winneg, PhD, in an APPC news release. “As the epidemiology of mpox changes, public understanding of who is at risk, how the virus spreads, and how vaccination can protect against it needs to keep pace.” Signs of progress, persistent misinformation While some misperceptions about mpox persist—16% of respondents said that the virus was definitely or probably bioengineered in a laboratory (a claim without evidence), and 7% incorrectly said that receiving the COVID vaccine increases the risk of getting mpox—the survey showed some signs of increased knowledge about the viral illness and openness to vaccination. Nearly three quarters (73%) of respondents said they know that people with mpox should isolate until the rash is gone—an increase from 68% in 2024—and the same percentage of respondents said the benefits of being vaccinated against mpox outweigh the risks. Sixty-nine percent of people said they would be “somewhat” or “very” likely to get an mpox vaccine if they were exposed to the virus, with the proportion who said they were “very” likely increasing, from 38% in 2024 to 44% last month. The survey’s margin of error is plus or minus 3.2 percentage points. analysis.time: The survey was conducted from September 22 to October 5, 2026, with comparisons made to July 2024 and August 2022.
analysis.location_and_population: The survey targeted US adults, with 1,842 participants surveyed.
analysis.event: A survey conducted by the Annenberg Public Policy Center (APPC) at the University of Pennsylvania found that awareness of mpox among US adults has significantly decreased since 2022, with only 8% reporting awareness in the past month.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Awareness of mpox dropped from 11% in July 2024 to 8% in the most recent survey, representing an 80% decline since July 2022. Public understanding of mpox transmission, risk factors, and vaccination remains limited, with only 49% knowing how it spreads and 18% correctly identifying it as less contagious than COVID-19.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The CDC notes that mpox has transitioned toward endemic circulation, with ongoing low-level transmission. The survey highlights persistent knowledge gaps and misinformation, but also shows some signs of increased understanding, such as 73% knowing that people with mpox should isolate until the rash is gone.

analysis.brief_en: A survey by the Annenberg Public Policy Center (APPC) at the University of Pennsylvania reveals that awareness of mpox among US adults has significantly declined since 2022. In the most recent survey, conducted from September 22 to October 5, 2026, only 8% of 1,842 adults reported awareness of mpox in the past month, down from 11% in July 2024 and 80% lower than the 2022 level. The CDC notes that mpox has transitioned toward endemic circulation, with ongoing low-level transmission. Despite this, the survey shows some progress, such as 73% of respondents knowing that people with mpox should isolate until the rash is gone. However, knowledge gaps persist, with only 18% correctly identifying mpox as less contagious than COVID-19. Misinformation about the virus, including claims about its origin and transmission, remains prevalent, highlighting the need for improved public education.

news.title_zh: 随着猴痘的持续传播,2022年以来美国成年人对该病毒的认知度直线下降
news.source_body_en: A survey by the Annenberg Public Policy Center (APPC) at the University of Pennsylvania reveals that awareness of mpox among US adults has significantly declined since 2022. In the most recent survey, conducted from September 22 to October 5, 2026, only 8% of 1,842 adults reported awareness of mpox in the past month, down from 11% in July 2024 and 80% lower than the 2022 level. The CDC notes that mpox has transitioned toward endemic circulation, with ongoing low-level transmission. Despite this, the survey shows some progress, such as 73% of respondents knowing that people with mpox should isolate until the rash is gone. However, knowledge gaps persist, with only 18% correctly identifying mpox as less contagious than COVID-19. Misinformation about the virus, including claims about its origin and transmission, remains prevalent, highlighting the need for improved public education.

The investigation, published in the International Journal of Health Geographics by researchers Christian M. Ibolobolo, Harry César Kayembe, Didier Bompangue, and Dav M. Ebengo, evaluated how human mobility across fluvial corridors and constrained road systems reshapes pathogen diffusion between 2022 and 2025. In vast, forested tropical landscapes where degraded overland infrastructure leaves riverways as the primary avenues of transport, understanding the spatial architecture of disease transmission remains difficult due to the scarcity of empirical travel records and fragile surveillance networks. By evaluating an explicit compartmental framework against empirical case distributions, the team demonstrated that epidemic trajectories across rural territories are fundamentally conditioned by asymmetric connectivity rather than uniform spatial spread. Maï-Ndombe province exemplifies the severe physical and infrastructural frictions that govern movement throughout the central Congo Basin. Extending across a low-relief landscape with an average elevation of 500 meters above sea level, the province spans extensive alluvial plains and hydromorphic depressions. Tropical rainforest covers approximately 11,403.8 square kilometers, representing 87 percent of the territory across Oshwe, Kiri, Inongo, and northern Kutu, with 15.93 percent of these forest systems established directly on hydromorphic soils. Conversely, the southern and southwestern sectors, including Bolobo, Mushie, Kwamouth, Yumbi, and southern Kutu, exhibit savanna environments interspersed with gallery forest fragments. Infrastructure throughout the region remains sparse, featuring an average of only one health center per health zone across territories covering thousands of square kilometers. Subsistence farming dominates the rural economy, which relies heavily on extracting timber, fish, and agricultural products destined primarily for Kinshasa, leaving inter-zone circulation heavily dependent on navigable riverways. To capture the mechanical resistance exerted by this complex landscape, the authors formulated an integrated spatial framework linking environmental cost surfaces, interaction models, and compartmental disease dynamics. The researchers addressed three critical gaps in previous epidemiological literature: the absence of combined road and river networks within Mpox connectivity modeling in rural tropical Africa, the lack of quantified intra-provincial connectivity matrices in Maï-Ndombe, and the absence of direct comparative evaluations between metapopulation models operating with and without spatial connectivity. All spatial, demographic, and epidemiological layers were assembled from open-access databases, reprojected into the Universal Transverse Mercator coordinate system zone 33 South, and resampled via bilinear interpolation to a metric resolution of 30 meters. Epidemiological records were corrected for underreporting using the surveillance adequacy score, while Monte Carlo simulations quantified surrounding diagnostic and reporting uncertainties. Quantifying movement friction across varied terrain required an analytical hierarchy process capable of handling expert uncertainty without on-the-ground travel surveys. The research team applied a Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process to compute barrier weights across environmental criteria, representing qualitative pairwise comparisons using triangular fuzzy numbers and Chang’s defuzzification method. Friction coefficients were established for forest, open water, forest mosaic, hydromorphic zones, savanna, and topographic slope. Dense forest and water bodies emerged as dominant friction barriers, each receiving normalized weights of 0.31, followed by hydromorphic zones at 0.15, slope at 0.12, forest mosaics at 0.091, and savanna landscapes at 0.053. Travel speeds were categorized separately across transport modes, establishing velocities between 30 and 50 kilometers per hour along road paths and 5 to 10 kilometers per hour along navigable waterways, allowing a least-cost path algorithm to trace minimum friction paths between health zones. The resultant distance-cost matrices were incorporated into an enhanced gravity model designed to approximate inter-zone interaction volumes. Traditional Newtonian gravity formulations scale interaction proportional to origin and destination populations divided by squared Euclidean separation; the researchers enhanced this by substituting environmental friction costs and exponential deterrence functions. Health areas with populations below 50,000 residents were classified as origin zones, while zones exceeding 50,000 residents served as destination attractors. To simulate disease transmission, the computed connectivity flows were introduced into a spatialized metapopulation Susceptible-Exposed-Infected-Recovered system. The infection force was partitioned between an endogenous local transmission component representing contacts within individual health zones and an exogenous connectivity-driven component driven by incoming inter-zone interactions. Baseline parameters established an initial transmission rate of 0.4695, a progression rate of 0.8703 per week representing a 9- to 10-day incubation interval, and a recovery rate of 0.8023 per week, evaluated alongside a sensitivity weighting parameter bounded between 0.6 and 0.8. Structural analysis of the resulting mobility network confirmed extreme spatial concentration and inequality across provincial transit axes. Calculating network dispersion revealed a Gini coefficient of 0.65, demonstrating that the vast majority of spatial flows are concentrated along a small number of privileged navigational corridors. This systemic concentration was corroborated by a high coefficient of variation of 1.52 and a Shannon entropy value of 4.43, demonstrating that mobility in Maï-Ndombe is not dispersed randomly but instead organized along dominant structural axes. The primary interaction corridor follows the Lukenie, Fimi, and Kasai rivers, funneling regional movements directly through central river ports. Gravitational closeness centrality calculations confirmed this hierarchy, placing Bokoro at the operational center of the province with the highest centrality value of 0.00147, followed by Mushie at 0.00121, Yumbi at 0.00085, and Inongo at 0.000843, while peripheral zones such as Mimia, Oshwe, and Kiri recorded near-zero centrality scores. When these connectivity flows were evaluated against empirical case records from 2022, the aggregate provincial performance of the spatialized model exhibited an unexpected deterioration. The baseline SEIR formulation omitting connectivity yielded a root mean square error of 30.26 and a mean absolute error of 19.44 cases, whereas incorporating connectivity degraded the provincial fit, producing an RMSE of 44.38, an MAE of 30.12, and a negative relative precision change of minus 0.468. This aggregate loss in predictive accuracy demonstrates that, across the entire provincial expanse, epidemic dynamics are predominantly governed by endogenous local transmission chains rather than continuous inter-zone diffusion. The broad degradation reflects known operational limitations, including surveillance notification delays, systematic underreporting linked to geographic remoteness, and structural limitations within the gravity model formulation itself. Despite aggregate performance deterioration at the provincial level, zone-by-zone precision gain analyses revealed profound local predictive improvements within structurally connected transit hubs. In health zones situated along major navigable waterways, incorporating spatial interaction dramatically enhanced model accuracy: predictive precision improved by 59.8 percent in Bokoro, 33.3 percent in Mushie, and 17.3 percent in Nioki. These sharp improvements confirm that inter-zone mobility flows constitute an authentic and measurable driver of Mpox introduction and amplification within core river settlements. By contrast, structurally isolated peripheral zones exhibited substantial reductions in model fit, with predictive performance dropping by 46.1 percent in Kiri, 27.4 percent in Mimia, 22.4 percent in Oshwe, and 11.8 percent in Pendjua, where the gravity formulation overestimates exogenous exposure in areas dominated almost entirely by isolated local transmission. The authors highlighted several structural mechanisms to explain why the inclusion of connectivity produces this divergent pattern between central hubs and isolated peripheries. A critical factor is the gravity model’s reliance on static residential population counts as denominators within the exogenous force of infection. This static denominator fails to account for temporal fluctuations in the effective population physically present in each zone during seasonal travel periods, causing models to overestimate imported infection risk in remote locations. Furthermore, the linear partitioning of transmission rates through fixed sensitivity coefficients cannot fully capture non-linear threshold phenomena or the brief duration of contact that travelers experience at river destinations before returning home. In asymmetric hub-and-spoke networks, multi-directional flow exchanges can also dilute localized exposure, generating model discrepancies when return flows are omitted from static travel matrices. These analytical findings offer direct operational guidance for designing targeted public health interventions and surveillance architectures in resource-constrained tropical regions. Identifying Bokoro, Nioki, and Mushie as high-centrality relay nodes along the Lukenie, Fimi, and Kasai river corridors indicates that these hubs should be designated as permanent sentinel surveillance posts. Health authorities can maximize early outbreak detection by stationing mobile surveillance teams and pre-positioning diagnostic stockpiles at key river embarkation points during peak traffic periods and major market gatherings. Conversely, because conventional surveillance pipelines consistently fail to capture silent transmission across remote territories like Mimia, Oshwe, and Kiri, public health planners must prioritize decentralized community-based surveillance rather than centralized reporting systems across peripheral zones. To overcome current analytical constraints, the investigators outlined three clear methodological priorities for future epidemiological research in data-scarce environments. First, static gravity formulations must evolve into dynamic spatiotemporal metapopulation frameworks that explicitly parameterize destination residence times, capturing the precise proportion of time peripheral residents spend interacting within high-density river hubs. Second, the linear partitioning of transmission parameters should be replaced by spectral analyses of next-generation transmission matrices to mathematically determine exact invasion thresholds and vulnerability metrics without relying on arbitrary weighting constants. Finally, implementing field-collected travel diaries at primary river ports will provide empirical mobility parameters, reducing reliance on theoretical cost-distance calibrations and strengthening outbreak preparedness across the forested basins of Central Africa. news.title_zh: 河流连通性重组 猴痘 传播 刚果民主共和国农村地区的风险 - Bioengineer.org
news.source_body_en: A geographic modeling study conducted in Maï-Ndombe province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, between 2022 and 2025, reveals that river connectivity significantly influences Mpox transmission risk in rural areas. Published on November 18, 2026, the research, led by Christian M. Ibolobolo, Harry César Kayembe, Didier Bompangue, and Dav M. Ebengo, highlights how human mobility across fluvial corridors and limited road infrastructure reshape pathogen diffusion. The study found that epidemic patterns are driven by asymmetric connectivity rather than uniform spatial spread, with a Gini coefficient of 0.65 showing that most spatial flows concentrate along key navigational corridors. The researchers used an integrated spatial framework combining environmental cost surfaces, interaction models, and compartmental disease dynamics to analyze movement friction across varied terrain. They also applied a Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process to compute barrier weights and used Monte Carlo simulations to address uncertainties in surveillance and reporting. The findings suggest that Bokoro, Nioki, and Mushie should be designated as permanent sentinel surveillance posts due to their high-centrality roles in the Lukenie, Fimi, and Kasai river corridors. The study underscores the importance of understanding spatial connectivity in disease modeling for effective public health interventions.
news.content_zh: 2022 年至 2025 年间在刚果民主共和国马伊-恩东贝省进行的一项地理模型研究表明,河流连通性显着影响农村地区的 猴痘 传播 风险。这项研究于 2026 年 11 月 18 日发表,由 Christian M. Ibolobolo、Harry César Kayembe、Didier Bompangue 和 Dav M. Ebengo 领导,强调了人类跨越河流走廊和有限的道路基础设施的流动如何重塑病原体的扩散。研究发现,流行病模式是由不对称的连通性而非均匀的空间传播驱动的,基尼系数为0.65,表明大多数空间流动集中在关键的航行走廊沿线。研究人员使用一个综合空间框架,结合环境成本面、相互作用模型和分区疾病动态来分析不同地形上的运动摩擦。他们还应用模糊层次分析过程来计算障碍权重,并使用蒙特卡洛模拟来解决 监测 和报告中的不确定性。研究结果表明,Bokoro、Nioki 和 Mushie 应被指定为永久哨兵 监测,因为它们在 Lukenie、Fimi 和 Kasai 河流走廊中具有高度中心作用。该研究强调了了解疾病模型中的空间连通性对于有效的公共卫生干预措施的重要性。

news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Monday, November 23, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Health Replication-Competent Mpox Virus and Drug Resistance Found in Advanced HIV Autopsy by November 18, 2026 in Health Reading Time: 2 mins read 0 Replication-Competent Mpox Virus and Drug Resistance Found in Advanced HIV Autopsy Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram Researchers identified replication-competent mpox virus (MPXV) within the central nervous system (CNS) of a deceased patient who suffered from advanced human immunodeficiency virus (HIV-1). The autopsy study was conducted on a fatal case of mpox following the global MPXV clade IIb outbreak of more than 100,000 cases. The patient had achieved viral suppression of HIV but continued to exhibit poor immune reconstitution despite more than six months of antiretroviral therapy. The clinical course was marked by progressive necrotizing mucocutaneous mpox disease that persisted despite the administration of multiple prolonged mpox-targeted therapies. To investigate the scope of the infection, the study team conducted an extensive autopsy, quantifying MPXV DNA across 76 samples collected from diverse anatomical sites throughout the body. While the highest viral burden was identified in skin and mucosal tissues, the analysis also confirmed the presence of the virus in all central nervous system tissues tested. Crucially, the researchers detected replication-competent MPXV in multiple CNS tissues, providing evidence that the virus can actively persist in these regions. Using RNA-scope in situ hybridization, the team confirmed that both neuronal and glial cells were infected by the virus. Discover more Check Symptoms Read Med Journals Track Outbreaks Study Biology drug resistance Genomic sequencing of samples obtained from body and brain tissues revealed widespread tecovirimat resistance-associated variants. By demonstrating that replication-competent MPXV and tecovirimat-resistant isolates can both infect and persist in the CNS, this case study provides essential data for future therapeutic design. analysis.brief_en: A study published on November 18, 2026, by Bioengineer.org reports the discovery of replication-competent mpox virus (MPXV) and drug resistance in the central nervous system (CNS) of a deceased patient with advanced HIV-1. The autopsy, which analyzed 76 samples from various anatomical sites, confirmed the presence of MPXV in all tested CNS tissues. Genomic sequencing revealed widespread tecovirimat resistance-associated variants, highlighting the potential for persistent viral infection despite antiretroviral therapy. The findings suggest that MPXV can actively replicate in the CNS and may be resistant to current treatments, providing critical insights for future therapeutic development. This case study does not report any public health response or broader outbreak data, focusing instead on the biological implications of the virus's presence in the CNS of an HIV-positive individual.

news.source_body_en: A study published on November 18, 2026, by Bioengineer.org reports the discovery of replication-competent mpox virus (MPXV) and drug resistance in the central nervous system (CNS) of a deceased patient with advanced HIV-1. The autopsy, which analyzed 76 samples from various anatomical sites, confirmed the presence of MPXV in all tested CNS tissues. Genomic sequencing revealed widespread tecovirimat resistance-associated variants, highlighting the potential for persistent viral infection despite antiretroviral therapy. The findings suggest that MPXV can actively replicate in the CNS and may be resistant to current treatments, providing critical insights for future therapeutic development. This case study does not report any public health response or broader outbreak data, focusing instead on the biological implications of the virus's presence in the CNS of an HIV-positive individual.

news.content_title: Cambodia Records First Mpox Case in 30 Months
news.content: Health Cambodia Records First Mpox Case in 30 Months FILE PHOTO: A nurse stands next to a newly created mpox isolation ward at a civil hospital in Ahmedabad on September 10, 2024. Formerly known as monkeypox, mpox is an infectious disease caused by a virus transmitted to humans by infected animals that can also be passed from human to human through close physical contact. (Photo by Sam PANTHAKY / AFP) By: Meng Seavmey November 22, 2026 , 12:28 PM 00:00 / 01:26 PHNOM PENH – Cambodia has recorded the first infection of Mpox, or monkeypox, case in 30 months and six days. The last one had appeared in 2024. The Ministry of Health on Nov. 22 confirmed the new case, reporting that the patient is under medical care at a hospital. Mpox is an infectious disease that can be deadly for people with weak immune systems. It causes several painful symptoms such as rash, enlarged lymph nodes, fever, headache, muscle ache, back pain and low energy. Cambodia had confirmed 20 cases of Mpox between Dec. 12, 2023, and May 14, 2024. Patients with Mpox can recover within two to four weeks. The Ministry of Health has issued an alert, telling the public to increase vigilance regarding their health and that of their families to prevent infection. The virus is transmitted from person to person through all forms of sexual contact and through direct contact with wounds, body fluids, saliva and equipment contaminated with the virus. If a pregnant woman has the virus, it can be transmitted to her child through the placenta during or after birth, according to the World Health Organization. The complications from mpox can be deadly and cause a higher risk of serious illness and death for children, pregnant women and people with weak immune systems, which also includes people living with HIV. The Ministry of Health has issued some prevention measures for people to take. They include: having safe sexual contact with protection; avoiding multiple sexual partners; avoiding direct contact with Mpox patients; avoiding contact with clothes, mattresses or pillows, towels, and dining materials used by Mpox patients; and avoiding contact with body fluids or saliva of Mpox patients. People, especially individuals who look after Mpox patients, are urged to practice regular daily sanitary measures, especially washing their hands with soap and alcohol gels. People who believe they might be experiencing the mentioned symptoms as well individuals diagnosed with the infection must remain away from people with no Mpox, and this, until all scabs fall from their skin and until they are tested negative for the virus. news.content: SingaporeInternationalChinaBusinessOpinionLifestyleEntertainment Search Cambodia reports first mpox case in two and a half years AI-translated article with transliterated names. Read original Chinese article here. Cambodia has confirmed its first mpox case in two and a half years, prompting the authorities to remind the public to take precautions. (Illustrative image) Cambodia has confirmed a new mpox case, its first in two and a half years. The Cambodian health ministry said in a statement on Sunday (22 November) that the patient was diagnosed with mpox on Friday (20 November) and is receiving treatment in hospital, Xinhua reported. “This is the first new case detected in Cambodia after 30 months and six days without any reported mpox cases,” the ministry said. The statement gave no further details. Cambodia previously reported a total of 20 mpox cases between December 2023 and May 2024. The health ministry urged the public to remain vigilant and protect their own health and that of their families to prevent clusters or large-scale outbreaks. The statement also advised anyone who develops a blistering rash on the face, palms, feet, body, eyes, mouth or genitals, accompanied by symptoms such as fever, swollen lymph nodes, headache, muscle aches, lower back pain and fatigue, to seek medical advice at a medical centre or hospital, or get tested for mpox. This is an AI-translated article and some names may be transliterated. The original Chinese text remains authoritative, and SPH Media is not responsible for translation errors. See Full Bio Follow: The Associated Press The Associated Press See Full Bio Follow: Nov 21, 2026, 04:01 PM ET LocalNewskywnewsradio PHILADELPHIA (KYW Newsradio) — It’s been four years since the global mpox virus outbreak. A new survey found that even though cases persist in the United States, public awareness remains low. The Annenberg Public Policy Center of the University of Pennsylvania conducted an mpox, also known as monkeypox, survey that concluded in October. It found that familiarity with the virus remains low, few worry about contracting it, and knowledge about the vaccine has not improved, with less than half not knowing a vaccine even exists. About 33% know that men who have sex with men are at higher risk of mpox infection. Mpox was first identified by scientists in 1958 when monkeys had an outbreak of a “pox-like” disease. Until about a few years ago, it was mainly seen in people in central and West Africa who had close contact with infected animals. There are two types: clade I and clade II. In 2022, the virus was confirmed to spread through sex. According to the Associated Press, there were outbreaks in more than 70 countries across the world that had not previously reported mpox. Those cases trace mainly to clade II, according to the CDC. Two years later, in 2024, cases jumped globally because of a new form of mpox that caused milder symptoms and lesions on the genitals, making it harder to detect and easier to spread. The vast majority of cases were in Burundi, Uganda, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Mpox belongs to the same family of viruses as smallpox but causes milder symptoms like fever, chills and body aches. People with more serious cases can develop lesions on the face, hands, chest and genitals. It’s not an airborne disease and typically requires close, skin-to-skin contact to spread. The two-dose JYNNEOS vaccine is recommended for those at increased risk of monkeypox. As of October, the CDC has reported more than 200 clade I monkeypox cases in at least 31 states and Puerto Rico. According to the study, there are some signs of increased knowledge about the virus. About 30% are aware it can spread through the placenta of a pregnant person who has mpox, an increase from 21% in July 2024. About 73% know that people with mpox should isolate at home until the rash is gone. That’s up 68% from two years ago. mpox monkeypox Around the Web Costco Shoppers Are Going Nuts for These Hearing Aids Nebroo Hearing Aids I Thought It Was a Regular Mug Until I Added Hot Water Peoasis Here Are 27 of The Coolest Gifts for This 2026 topchicdeals Looking for a Unique Gift? analysis.time: The survey was concluded in October 2026, with the news published on November 21, 2026. The study notes that mpox cases have persisted in the US for four years since the global outbreak, and there were outbreaks in more than 70 countries globally in recent years. In 2024, cases jumped due to a new form of mpox that caused milder symptoms and easier spread.
analysis.location_and_population: The survey was conducted in the United States, specifically in Philadelphia, and involved the general population. The CDC reported more than 200 clade I monkeypox cases in at least 31 states and Puerto Rico as of October 2026.
analysis.event: A survey conducted by the Annenberg Public Policy Center of the University of Pennsylvania found that public awareness of mpox remains low, with less than half of respondents knowing a vaccine exists. The survey also noted that 33% of respondents are aware that men who have sex with men are at higher risk of mpox infection, and there are some signs of increased knowledge about the virus, such as 30% knowing it can spread through the placenta of a pregnant person.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Mpox cases persist in the US and have been reported in more than 70 countries globally. The CDC reported over 200 clade I cases in at least 31 states and Puerto Rico. The virus spreads through close, skin-to-skin contact and can cause lesions on the face, hands, chest, and genitals. The study highlights that the virus is not airborne and that the majority of cases are in Burundi, Uganda, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The CDC recommends the two-dose JYNNEOS vaccine for those at increased risk. The survey indicates some increased awareness, such as 73% knowing that people with mpox should isolate at home until the rash is gone, up from 21% in July 2024. The study is a survey and does not provide confirmed outbreak data, but it highlights ongoing public health concerns.

analysis.brief_en: A survey by the Annenberg Public Policy Center of the University of Pennsylvania, concluded in October 2026, found that public awareness of mpox remains low in the United States, despite persistent cases. The survey noted that less than half of respondents are aware of the existence of a vaccine, and only 33% know that men who have sex with men are at higher risk of infection. While the CDC has reported over 200 clade I mpox cases in at least 31 states and Puerto Rico, the virus is not airborne and spreads through close, skin-to-skin contact. The study also highlights some increased knowledge, such as 30% of respondents knowing that mpox can spread through the placenta of a pregnant person, up from 21% in July 2024. The survey does not provide confirmed outbreak data but underscores ongoing public health concerns regarding mpox awareness and prevention.

analysis_zh.event: 宾夕法尼亚大学安纳伯格公共政策中心进行的一项调查发现,公众对 猴痘 的认知度仍然较低,只有不到一半的受访者知道 疫苗 的存在。调查还指出,33%的受访者意识到男男性行为者感染猴痘的风险较高,并且有一些迹象表明人们对该病毒的了解有所增加,例如30%的受访者知道该病毒可以通过孕妇的胎盘传播。
analysis_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: 猴痘 病例持续存在于美国,并已在全球 70 多个国家/地区报告。CDC 报告了至少 31 个州和波多黎各的 200 多例 I 型病例。该病毒通过密切的皮肤接触传播,可能导致面部、手、胸部和生殖器损伤。该研究强调,该病毒不是通过空气传播的,大多数病例发生在布隆迪、乌干达和刚果民主共和国。
analysis_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: CDC 建议高危人群服用两剂 JYNNEOS 疫苗。该调查表明,人们的认识有所提高,例如 73% 的人知道 猴痘 患者应该在家隔离直到皮疹消失,这一比例高于 2024 年 7 月的 21%。该研究是一项调查,并未提供经证实的 暴发 数据,但它强调了持续存在的公共卫生问题。

Open image viewer File photo. Image: Jaana Polamo / Yle Yle News 19.11. 12:18 A case of mpox, previously called monkeypox, has been detected at a daycare centre in Turku. The southwestern city's child and youth services chief Anu Parantainen confirmed the matter to Yle on Thursday, saying she learned about the case the previous day. Operations at the daycare centre in question are continuing normally, the city said. According to Turku's Service Area Director Vesa Kulmala, the city has contacted those potentially exposed to the infectious illness. The city has not disclosed which daycare facility was affected or whether the infected individual was a child or a staff member. Mpox is a viral illness that spread from the animal kingdom to humans. Symptoms include a skin rash that progresses from blisters to crusted lesions, along with fever, headache and swollen lymph nodes. Specialist: Mpox not generally dangerous According to the City of Turku, this was the first time mpox has been detected at a daycare centre in the city. Chief infectious disease specialist Mari Kanerva from Turku University Hospital said that until now, the disease had not been detected in the Southwest Finland welfare region. Kanerva said mpox is not classified as a generally dangerous infectious disease. According to the Institute for Health and Welfare (THL), mpox can be transmitted from person to person through skin or mucous membrane contact, sexual activity, or through droplets from prolonged face-to-face contact. It can also be transmitted via shared towels or bed linen. The disease often resolves on its own within a few weeks, according to the health agency. Good hand hygiene and cough etiquette reduce the risk of transmission. So far this year, there have been 12 confirmed cases of mpox detected in Finland, according to THL — more than in recent years. The previous peak in infections was in 2022, when more than 40 cases were detected. analysis_zh.location_and_population: 该病例是在芬兰图尔库的一个日托中心发现的。该市尚未透露哪个具体设施受到影响,也没有透露感染者是儿童还是工作人员。
analysis_zh.event: 芬兰图尔库的一家日托中心确诊了一例 猴痘 病例。该市儿童和青少年服务负责人于 2026 年 11 月 17 日星期四向 Yle 确认了此案。
analysis_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: 这是 猴痘 首次在图尔库的日托中心被发现。这种疾病不属于一般危险疾病,通常会在几周内自行消退。该市已联系那些可能接触该传染病的人。
analysis_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 该市尚未透露有关受影响设施或感染者的具体细节。应对措施包括接触者追踪以及与潜在暴露者的沟通。卫生机构建议保持良好的手部卫生和咳嗽礼仪,以降低 传播 风险。

The confirmation highlights the presence of the virus in the region, and health authorities are advising individuals at higher risk to consider vaccination. news.content_title: Nature | 痘病毒内核上的神秘通道:李赛实验室破解“分子门户”的身份与结构之谜
news.content: 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 Nature | 痘病毒内核上的神秘通道:李赛实验室破解“分子门户”的身份与结构之谜 2026-11-21 17:27 来源: 城市线上生活 发布于:山西省 痘病毒是一种古老的,直径达200-360 nm的巨型囊膜病毒。作为庞大双链DNA病毒家族的成员,正痘病毒属包含天花病毒、猴痘病毒,及被广泛用作疫苗载体的痘苗病毒。尽管世界卫生组织(WHO)于1980年宣布天花已被彻底根除,但正痘病毒对人类的威胁并未消失。近年猴痘病毒在全球持续流行,至2026年7月,全球共计145个国家/地区报告确诊逾19万例猴痘感染病例,致500多例患者死亡。这些疫情警示,正痘病毒对人类健康构成持续威胁。 11月16日,《自然》(Nature)杂志以“加速预览”形式发表清华大学生命学院李赛团队题为“嵌在痘病毒内核上的门户复合物的结构 (Architecture of a portal complex embedded in the poxvirus core)”的学术文章。 在冷冻电镜时代,科学家尝试对痘病毒进行高分辨成像和原位结构解析,这面临三项艰巨挑战:1)这种形似砖头的病毒尺寸为200-360 nm,为电子穿透和拍照效率带来极大挑战(图1);2)病毒形态多样,无法通过平均整颗病毒粒子得到结构;3)它编码200种蛋白,大部分的结构和功能未知,难以进行建模。 图1:痘病毒与李赛实验室研究的其他囊膜病毒的尺度比较 与在宿主细胞核内转录的DNA病毒不同,痘病毒自带一座由致密栅栏蛋白包裹、形似装甲车的“转录工厂”,在细胞质中完成转录。然而,这种密闭的内核结构缺乏足以让较大生物分子自由穿过的间隙(图2a)。这便引出一个困扰多年的问题:这座“装甲工厂”,怎样与外界进行物质交换? 为回答这个问题,李赛实验室于2024年利用冷冻电子断层成像(cryo-ET)技术,对灭活猴痘病毒进行成像和结构解析时,意外发现一种“花瓣状”的大型分子复合物,猜测它可能是调控病毒早期转录的重要机器(1)。然而,受限于猴痘样品的实验局限,该复合物的分辨率仅达到~20 Å,无法判断其蛋白组分,因此研究团队转而研究痘苗病毒。 研究揭示,每个病毒内核表面平均分布着约20个门户复合物。这些结构贯穿内核壁,连接其内部与外部空间。这座直径约12 nm的“分子门户”具有精巧的六重对称结构,由多个蛋白质亚基组装形成,并通过复杂的互作网络嵌入内核壁。 图2:痘苗病毒内核的高分辨结构。含(a)tomogram slice,内核结构,(b)门户复合物和(c)孔道复合物的结构与分布 展开全文 图2:痘苗病毒内核的高分辨结构。含(a)tomogram slice,内核结构,(b)门户复合物和(c)孔道复合物的结构与分布 孔道复合物由四个六聚体环层层堆叠构成,犹如“少女的盛装”:顶部的“衣领(Collar)”、中部的“上衣(Coat)”,以及基部外侧的“裙子(Skirt)”与内侧的“衬裙(Petticoat)”。四层环环相扣:Coat嵌入内核壁、连接上下部分,Collar扣在Coat上方,Petticoat则围绕在通道最窄处(图3a)。 图3:痘苗病毒孔道复合物的蛋白身份和组装规律 通过整合早期功能学研究、冷冻电镜密度图特征及AlphaFold3结构预测,作者确定出复合物的蛋白身份:E6搭起中部Coat的骨架,E8构成顶部Collar,L3以两种构象分别形成Skirt与Petticoat(图3b)。三者按6:6:12的化学计量组装,接触面上的电荷高度互补,像榫卯一样彼此咬合,把这座“门”牢牢固定住。 进一步分析,研究人员发现孔道中央L3上的四个赖氨酸围成了一条长约2 nm、内径约16.5 Å且富含正电的管道。这一狭窄区在尺寸上恰好容许单链RNA及小分子原料的通过,却不足以容纳更大的双链DNA或细胞质DNA感受器(图4)。不仅如此,该狭窄区在正痘病毒属内高度保守,提示该结构可能在痘病毒生命活动中承担重要作用。 为探究其功能,中国疾病预防控制中心的谭文杰团队开展了病毒遗传学和细胞实验。他们发现,突变这四个赖氨酸中的任何一个均无法获得稳定的子代病毒。即使将其替换成同带正电荷的精氨酸,也无法完全恢复病毒功能。这表明,通道内这些氨基酸不仅需具备适当的电性,其精确的分子结构也可能对病毒复制至关重要。 图4: 孔道复合物的通道分析。四个赖氨酸残基(K261、K268、K270和K272)朝向通道内部排列,形成了一段特殊的“带正电荷的分子细管” 该研究不仅将此前模糊的痘病毒门户复合物推进至明确的原子模型,更证明了L3蛋白上的K261、K268、K270位点在病毒复制周期中发挥关键作用。这些在不同痘病毒中高度保守的位点,有望成为广谱抗痘病毒药物设计的全新靶点。 清华大学生命学院李赛副教授为本文通讯作者,2026届博士毕业生洪烨为本文第一作者。李赛团队博士研究生王柯人、博士后梁瑞、张俊霞(已出站)、彭程、博士生张哲源、张伟平;中国疾病预防控制中心病毒病预防控制所谭文杰教授、其团队研究生刘士元(已毕业)、黄保英研究员;北京大学定量生物学中心宋晨教授、其团队博士研究生朱泽锋(已毕业)参与研究。 感谢清华大学生命学院张强锋副教授、基础医学院丁强副教授在模型搭建和病毒学方面的建议,以及蛋白质科学技术中心冷冻电镜设施、生物计算平台和清华大学BSL-2公共平台的支持。 研究得到国家自然科学基金、教育部高教司及清华大学笃实专项基金的资助,及北京生物结构前沿研究中心、膜生物学全国重点实验室、清华-北大生命联合中心和生命科学人工智能研究中心的长期支持。 参考文献 1. Y. Hong et al., Molecular architecture of monkeypox mature virus. Cell Discov 10, 108 (2024). 2. J. Liu et al., A multimeric pore complex in the poxvirus core revealed by integrative structural analysis. Nat Commun 17, (2026). 3. T. Calcraft, M. Hernandez-Gonzalez, M. Way, P. B. Rosenthal, In situ structure of the poxvirus portal complex. Nature, (2026). 4. Z. Zhang et al., FlyTomo: a streamlined software for on-the-fly cryo-ET data processing and diagnosis. 为回答这个问题,李赛实验室于2024年利用冷冻电子断层成像(cryo-ET)技术,对灭活猴痘病毒进行成像和结构解析时,意外发现一种“花瓣状”的大型分子复合物,猜测它可能是调控病毒早期转录的重要机器(1)。然而,受限于猴痘样品的实验局限,该复合物的分辨率仅达到~20 Å,无法判断其蛋白组分,因此研究团队转而研究痘苗病毒。 研究揭示,每个病毒内核表面平均分布着约20个门户复合物。这些结构贯穿内核壁,连接其内部与外部空间。这座直径约12 nm的“分子门户”具有精巧的六重对称结构,由多个蛋白质亚基组装形成,并通过复杂的互作网络嵌入内核壁。 图2:痘苗病毒内核的高分辨结构。含(a)tomogram slice,内核结构,(b)门户复合物和(c)孔道复合物的结构与分布 展开全文 图2:痘苗病毒内核的高分辨结构。含(a)tomogram slice,内核结构,(b)门户复合物和(c)孔道复合物的结构与分布 孔道复合物由四个六聚体环层层堆叠构成,犹如“少女的盛装”:顶部的“衣领(Collar)”、中部的“上衣(Coat)”,以及基部外侧的“裙子(Skirt)”与内侧的“衬裙(Petticoat)”。四层环环相扣:Coat嵌入内核壁、连接上下部分,Collar扣在Coat上方,Petticoat则围绕在通道最窄处(图3a)。 图3:痘苗病毒孔道复合物的蛋白身份和组装规律 通过整合早期功能学研究、冷冻电镜密度图特征及AlphaFold3结构预测,作者确定出复合物的蛋白身份:E6搭起中部Coat的骨架,E8构成顶部Collar,L3以两种构象分别形成Skirt与Petticoat(图3b)。三者按6:6:12的化学计量组装,接触面上的电荷高度互补,像榫卯一样彼此咬合,把这座“门”牢牢固定住。 进一步分析,研究人员发现孔道中央L3上的四个赖氨酸围成了一条长约2 nm、内径约16.5 Å且富含正电的管道。这一狭窄区在尺寸上恰好容许单链RNA及小分子原料的通过,却不足以容纳更大的双链DNA或细胞质DNA感受器(图4)。不仅如此,该狭窄区在正痘病毒属内高度保守,提示该结构可能在痘病毒生命活动中承担重要作用。 为探究其功能,中国疾病预防控制中心的谭文杰团队开展了病毒遗传学和细胞实验。他们发现,突变这四个赖氨酸中的任何一个均无法获得稳定的子代病毒。即使将其替换成同带正电荷的精氨酸,也无法完全恢复病毒功能。这表明,通道内这些氨基酸不仅需具备适当的电性,其精确的分子结构也可能对病毒复制至关重要。 图4: 孔道复合物的通道分析。四个赖氨酸残基(K261、K268、K270和K272)朝向通道内部排列,形成了一段特殊的“带正电荷的分子细管” 该研究不仅将此前模糊的痘病毒门户复合物推进至明确的原子模型,更证明了L3蛋白上的K261、K268、K270位点在病毒复制周期中发挥关键作用。这些在不同痘病毒中高度保守的位点,有望成为广谱抗痘病毒药物设计的全新靶点。 清华大学生命学院李赛副教授为本文通讯作者,2026届博士毕业生洪烨为本文第一作者。李赛团队博士研究生王柯人、博士后梁瑞、张俊霞(已出站)、彭程、博士生张哲源、张伟平;中国疾病预防控制中心病毒病预防控制所谭文杰教授、其团队研究生刘士元(已毕业)、黄保英研究员;北京大学定量生物学中心宋晨教授、其团队博士研究生朱泽锋(已毕业)参与研究。 感谢清华大学生命学院张强锋副教授、基础医学院丁强副教授在模型搭建和病毒学方面的建议,以及蛋白质科学技术中心冷冻电镜设施、生物计算平台和清华大学BSL-2公共平台的支持。 研究得到国家自然科学基金、教育部高教司及清华大学笃实专项基金的资助,及北京生物结构前沿研究中心、膜生物学全国重点实验室、清华-北大生命联合中心和生命科学人工智能研究中心的长期支持。 参考文献 1. Y. Hong et al., Molecular architecture of monkeypox mature virus. Cell Discov 10, 108 (2024). 2. J. Liu et al., A multimeric pore complex in the poxvirus core revealed by integrative structural analysis. Nat Commun 17, (2026). 3. T. Calcraft, M. Hernandez-Gonzalez, M. Way, P. B. Rosenthal, In situ structure of the poxvirus portal complex. Nature, (2026). 4. Z. Zhang et al., FlyTomo: a streamlined software for on-the-fly cryo-ET data processing and diagnosis. 柬埔寨卫生部11月22日发布声明说,该国发现一例猴痘(mpox)病例,这是柬埔寨连续30个月零6天没有病例后的首例,也是时隔约两年半再次出现猴痘。据新华社报道,这名患者于11月20日检测呈阳性,目前正在医院接受治疗。卫生部没有公布患者的其他信息。 资料图片 / Pexels(柬埔寨首都金边) 上一轮疫情20例 柬埔寨此前在2023年12月至2024年5月期间累计报告20例猴痘病例,之后一直没有新增。 卫生部在声明中呼吁民众保持警惕,保护自己和家人的健康,防止出现聚集性病例或大规模暴发。 怎么传播、有哪些症状 声明说,猴痘病毒可以通过各种形式的性接触在人与人之间传播,也可以通过直接接触患者的伤口、体液、唾液或被污染的物品传播;孕妇还可能在怀孕期间或分娩后把病毒传给胎儿。 卫生部提醒,脸部、手掌、脚底、身体、眼睛、口腔或生殖器出现水疱样皮疹,同时伴有发烧、淋巴结肿大、头痛、肌肉酸痛、腰痛和乏力等症状的人,应到卫生中心或医院就诊,或接受猴痘检测。 资料图片 / Pexels(柬埔寨金边夜景) 相关报道: 世卫:猴痘仍是公共卫生紧急事件 新西兰一天新增3例猴痘病例 都与皇后镇骄傲节有关 消息来源:新华社 编辑:忆雪 版权声明 1. 柬埔寨此前在2023年12月至2024年5月期间累计报告20例猴痘病例,之后一直没有新增。 卫生部在声明中呼吁民众保持警惕,保护自己和家人的健康,防止出现聚集性病例或大规模暴发。 怎么传播、有哪些症状 声明说,猴痘病毒可以通过各种形式的性接触在人与人之间传播,也可以通过直接接触患者的伤口、体液、唾液或被污染的物品传播;孕妇还可能在怀孕期间或分娩后把病毒传给胎儿。 卫生部提醒,脸部、手掌、脚底、身体、眼睛、口腔或生殖器出现水疱样皮疹,同时伴有发烧、淋巴结肿大、头痛、肌肉酸痛、腰痛和乏力等症状的人,应到卫生中心或医院就诊,或接受猴痘检测。 资料图片 / Pexels(柬埔寨金边夜景) 相关报道: 世卫:猴痘仍是公共卫生紧急事件 新西兰一天新增3例猴痘病例 都与皇后镇骄傲节有关 消息来源:新华社 编辑:忆雪 版权声明 1. analysis.brief_en: On November 22, 2026, the Cambodian Ministry of Health announced the first confirmed case of monkeypox in the country in approximately two and a half years. The patient, who was diagnosed on November 20, is currently hospitalized. This marks the resumption of monkeypox cases in Cambodia after a period of 30 months and 6 days without any reported cases. The ministry emphasized the importance of vigilance and urged individuals to seek medical attention if they exhibit symptoms such as blister-like rashes on the face, hands, feet, or other body parts, along with fever, swollen lymph nodes, and muscle pain. The transmission routes include sexual contact and direct contact with the patient's wounds, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects. No specific risk level or further details about the outbreak's scale or impact were provided. The response includes public health advisories but no detailed investigation or containment measures were mentioned.

supplementary_news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Monday, November 23, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Health Nationwide US Surveillance Tracks Mpox Clade IIb Evolution and Clade Ib Introductions by November 19, 2026 in Health Reading Time: 3 mins read 0 Nationwide US Surveillance Tracks Mpox Clade IIb Evolution and Clade Ib Introductions Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram A nationwide genomic surveillance initiative across the United States has tracked the ongoing evolution of mpox virus, identifying two separate introductions of clade Ib alongside extensive genetic shifts in clade IIb. Researchers generated and analyzed 326 high-quality whole-genome sequences from residual clinical specimens collected between August 2024 and June 2025. The investigation captured significant patterns of viral adaptation, including characteristic human enzymatic mutation signatures and structural genomic deletions. The surveillance platform was established by building upon existing SARS-CoV-2 sequencing infrastructure to monitor mpox virus transmission dynamics following the 2022 to 2023 global outbreak. Clinical samples were obtained by Labcorp across all ten United States Department of Health and Human Services regions, providing comprehensive geographic coverage of circulating viral strains. This continuous nationwide sampling framework was designed to assess shifting lineage diversity and detect emerging genetic variants in clinical populations. To process residual mpox-positive clinical specimens, the investigators deployed a Molecular Loop probe-based long-read sequencing protocol utilizing Pacific Biosciences Sequel II technology. The long-read sequencing methodology generated complete genomic profiles, allowing researchers to evaluate both conserved core genomic regions and complex variable terminal ends. The assay demonstrated high technical reproducibility across biological replicates taken from individual patients during routine testing. Genomic characterization of the dataset identified two distinct clinical specimens containing clade Ib mpox virus, detected in January 2025 and June 2025. In addition to detecting clade Ib entries into the United States, the surveillance captured evolving patterns within clade IIb, revealing twelve distinct circulating lineages. Researchers also uncovered multiple structural alterations within clade IIb genomes, specifically large deletions ranging from approximately 1.6 to 17.6 kilobases positioned proximal to the inverted terminal repeats. Mutational analysis of the recovered viral sequences demonstrated clear hallmarks of host-mediated editing driven by APOBEC3 cytidine deaminases across both clade Ib and clade IIb samples. These specific mutation patterns provide substantial molecular evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission. Furthermore, the researchers detected significantly higher rates of APOBEC3-associated single nucleotide polymorphisms per kilobase in the variable regions of clade IIb genomes compared to the central conserved core region, with a statistical significance of P less than 0.001. Analytical accuracy of the probe-based sequencing approach was verified through parallel metagenomic sequencing conducted by the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention on selected clinical specimens. In addition, custom computational simulations confirmed that the long-read probe assay reliably discriminates between all known mpox virus clades and lineages, including lineages not previously documented in circulating United States samples. The authors concluded that the integrated nationwide surveillance architecture enables effective real-time tracking of pathogen outbreak evolution. Having established operational capacity for both SARS-CoV-2 and mpox virus, the genomic surveillance pipeline provides a validated technological foundation prepared for rapid deployment during potential future infectious disease emergence events. The patient tested positive for the disease on Friday and is currently receiving treatment in a hospital, the statement said, without providing further details. Previously, Cambodia recorded 20 mpox cases between December 2023 and May 2024. "This new detection is the first case after Cambodia had not recorded any cases of the disease for the past 30 months and six days," the ministry stated. The ministry urged all citizens to remain vigilant and protect their health and that of their families to prevent clusters or large-scale outbreaks. According to the statement, the mpox virus spreads from person to person through all forms of sexual contact, as well as direct contact with wounds, body fluids, saliva, or contaminated materials. It can also be transmitted from a pregnant woman to her fetus via the umbilical cord during pregnancy or after birth. "Individuals experiencing symptoms such as a blistering rash on the face, palms, feet, body, eyes, mouth, or genitals, along with fever, swollen lymph nodes, headache, muscle aches, lower back pain and fatigue, should visit a health center or hospital for consultation or mpox testing," the statement advised. - Xinhua Follow us on our official WhatsApp channel for breaking news alerts and key updates! Subscribe More forecasts: Atlanta 30 day forecast Denver/ Science, Tech & Medicine Metro Denver Resident Tests Positive for Clade I Mpox, Colorado Urges Vaccination By Hailey Armstrong Published on November 19, 2026 Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment — State Mpox Case Confirmation Google Street View A metro Denver resident has tested positive for clade I mpox, Colorado state health officials confirmed, as the state joins a growing list of jurisdictions reporting the more closely watched strain of the virus. Officials are now urging people at higher risk of exposure to consider getting vaccinated, even as they stress that danger to the general public remains very low. What Colorado Officials Are Saying State epidemiologist Rachel Herlihy said the risk to the general population remains very low despite clade I mpox being detected in Colorado, and she encouraged people at increased risk for exposure to consider getting vaccinated against mpox. Herlihy also noted that the JYNNEOS vaccine protects against both mpox clades, according to 9News. Colorado state health officials have confirmed the case in a metro Denver resident and are encouraging people at higher risk to consider vaccination. Clade I is one of two main types of virus that cause mpox, distinct from clade II, which caused the global mpox outbreak that began in 2022 and continues to circulate. Public health officials are tracking clade I closely because it has only recently begun spreading within the United States, and the Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment says it has historically been considered more severe than clade II. Even so, recent U.S. clade I cases have been relatively mild with no reported deaths. A National Trend of Domestic Spread The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has reported more than 200 clade I mpox cases across at least 31 states and Puerto Rico as of October, with the agency noting that some people in the United States have likely acquired clade I mpox domestically without a known connection to international travel. That national picture has been building for months. As of its October 5 update, the CDC put the national clade I case count at 80, according to Medscape, and by October 14 that figure had climbed past 90 cases in at least 23 states and Puerto Rico, per Medical Daily. The CDC has said cases with presumed domestic transmission had been reported in more than 10 jurisdictions nationwide, a pattern the agency says points toward a likely transition to sustained clade Ib transmission in the United States, as reported by Medical Daily. Globally, more than 300 clade Ib cases have been diagnosed in high-income countries without a single reported death, the same Medscape report notes. The CDC's own risk assessment has held steady: low for the general public, and low to moderate for men who have sex with men. Similar Cases Surfacing Elsewhere in the West Colorado is not the only state watching clade I activity turn up without obvious travel links. In California's Stanislaus County, health officials identified four recent mpox cases, and state officials confirmed two of them were clade I; three of the four patients had not traveled outside the country, the same outlet reports. That echoes a pattern seen in California roughly a year earlier, when the state confirmed three unrelated clade I cases in Long Beach and Los Angeles County among people with no international travel and no contact with one another. Who Is Considered Higher Risk, and Why Vaccination Matters Anyone can get mpox through close physical contact with someone who has it, according to CDPHE, since the virus spreads mainly through close physical contact, including sex, or indirect contact with an infected person's sores, bumps, or lesions. Brief interactions without physical contact are unlikely to spread mpox, the agency says. Men who have sex with men have been at higher risk for contracting mpox, and transgender women and gender-diverse people have also been disproportionately affected, per CDPHE. State health officials describe mpox vaccination as the best way to prevent the disease. Physicians elsewhere have echoed that message in clinical settings: infectious disease specialist Jason Zucker has advised doctors to use every office visit to offer and complete the two-dose JYNNEOS vaccine series for eligible at-risk patients, according to Medscape's report. In Stanislaus County, public health officials similarly recommended the two-dose JYNNEOS vaccine for several higher-risk groups, including gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men, Medical Daily reported. Recognizing Mpox Symptoms CDPHE lists mpox symptoms as including a new rash or bumps on the hands, feet, chest, face, mouth, near the genitals, or in the rectum, often alongside flu-like symptoms such as fever, chills, headache, fatigue, and muscle aches. The rash can resemble pimples or blisters and may be painful or itchy, and it typically goes through several stages, including scabs, before healing, the agency says. People who develop a new rash or bumps and think they may have been exposed should get tested for mpox even if they have been vaccinated or previously infected, according to CDPHE. The autopsy study was conducted on a fatal case of mpox following the global MPXV clade IIb outbreak of more than 100,000 cases. The patient had achieved viral suppression of HIV but continued to exhibit poor immune reconstitution despite more than six months of antiretroviral therapy. The clinical course was marked by progressive necrotizing mucocutaneous mpox disease that persisted despite the administration of multiple prolonged mpox-targeted therapies. To investigate the scope of the infection, the study team conducted an extensive autopsy, quantifying MPXV DNA across 76 samples collected from diverse anatomical sites throughout the body. While the highest viral burden was identified in skin and mucosal tissues, the analysis also confirmed the presence of the virus in all central nervous system tissues tested. Crucially, the researchers detected replication-competent MPXV in multiple CNS tissues, providing evidence that the virus can actively persist in these regions. Using RNA-scope in situ hybridization, the team confirmed that both neuronal and glial cells were infected by the virus. Genomic sequencing of samples obtained from body and brain tissues revealed widespread tecovirimat resistance-associated variants. By demonstrating that replication-competent MPXV and tecovirimat-resistant isolates can both infect and persist in the CNS, this case study provides essential data for future therapeutic design. supplementary_news.title: Survey Shows Public Awareness Remains Low as U.S. Mpox Cases Persist
